paragraph:
The price of a river
Water reform needs an account of power as well as a price for scarcity

An article set in the fictional town of Saint Orin.

At Saint Orin’s fortified abbey, the old (fosse) is dry. Beside a disused (warehouse), workers struggle with a rusted (floodgate). Residents must (traverse) narrow bridges to reach their homes across an (intricate) canal network. The mayor proposes to modernise everything through a water exchange. The maintenance team would welcome permission to order a replacement hinge.

The museum offers historical perspective. A token bears an abbot’s portrait on its (obverse) and a mill on its (reverse). These tokens (antedate) the municipal utility. The abbot, a (celibate) administrator later remembered as a (recluse), left both accounts and (verse). Visitors may (muse) on his priorities: his poetry celebrates heaven, but his ledgers concern water rights.

The leading mayoral (candidate) is an energetic (advocate) of market reform. She will (espouse) competition, seek a popular (mandate) and happily (pontificate) about efficiency. Her central argument is reasonable: users should face some cost for consuming a scarce resource. Whether her particular scheme allocates that resource fairly is a separate question.

The public (purse) already supports substantial (largesse). Officials (disburse) emergency aid, promise to (reimburse) farmers for damaged equipment and offer households a water-saving (rebate). These measures have different purposes. Combining them into one impressive spending total reveals little about which households receive help or whether consumption actually falls.

The distributional problem is awkward. Ability to pay can bear an (inverse) relationship to need. A uniform price increase may have especially (adverse) consequences for poor families, while exemptions for influential businesses create (perverse) incentives. A workable scheme must (accommodate) a (diverse) population without making every allocation depend on political connections.

Engineering presents different questions. Two perpendicular channels could be connected by a pipe following the triangle’s (hypotenuse). Elsewhere, a new channel would (bifurcate) before reaching competing farms. Maps can (delineate) the routes and (demarcate) ownership. They cannot determine, by geometry alone, whose claim should take precedence during a drought.

Public (debate) should make these choices visible. Instead, official (discourse) has become so (abstruse) that residents need advisers to (explicate) the tariff. A short worked example would (elucidate) its effects better than another strategy document. People cannot meaningfully support a reform whose consequences remain hidden behind terminology.

The stakes extend beyond garden sprinklers. Orchards may (desiccate), while factories need reliable systems to cool machinery and (lubricate) moving parts. Clinics require dependable water supplies while staff (medicate) patients or (transfuse) blood. For families dependent on failed harvests, the concern may simply be whether they can afford anything to (masticate).

The agricultural college teaches growers to (propagate) suitable crops and explains the conditions in which livestock (procreate). Its museum traces attempts to (domesticate) plants and animals. Today, instructors also try to (inculcate) habits of cooperation: neighbouring farms that share equipment should (reciprocate) assistance. Markets would enter an economy already held together partly by obligations.

Trading could allow users to (aggregate) small entitlements or (consolidate) operations. But a distressed farmer might also (liquidate) a valuable long-term right to meet an immediate bill. That transaction can be voluntary and still leave the community worse prepared for the next difficult season. Its consequences deserve more attention than the number of trades completed.

Nor does drought eliminate flood risk. Heavy rain could (inundate) fields whose drainage has been neglected. Poorly coordinated gates may (exacerbate) damage and (dislocate) families. Such interactions (complicate) the reform without necessarily defeating it. They do, however, (negate) the convenient assumption that efficient pricing can substitute for managing physical infrastructure.

Useful innovation is possible. A laboratory studies how salt crystals (nucleate) on sample surfaces; experimental crops (variegate) its surrounding plots. The college hopes to (incubate) local businesses and (diffuse) practical knowledge. Such work could (infuse) the reform with a concern for production. That concern needs to (permeate) contracts as well as conference speeches.

Reaching agreement will be (delicate). Subsidies offered merely to (placate) the loudest opponents may reward obstruction. Political (finesse) is valuable when it helps (defuse) genuine misunderstandings. The present (impasse), however, also reflects incompatible interests. Those will require explicit decisions about costs and rights, not just a better communications campaign.

Every contract should contain a clear (clause) explaining a user’s (recourse) when deliveries fail. An independent body must be able to (adjudicate) disputes. Meter readings might (indicate) an unauthorised diversion, and records could (implicate) an operator. Evidence must remain open to examination; an allegation should not become a verdict simply because it appears on a dashboard.

An audit has already led councillors to (accuse) a former treasurer of attempting to (defalcate) relief funds. He denies wrongdoing. The current administration should neither (prevaricate) about missing records nor (equivocate) about who must produce them. Technical complexity must not become a means to (obfuscate) responsibility. Trust requires a process capable of testing both accusations and denials.

The exchange’s promoters insist their proposal is no (ruse). They should nevertheless (disabuse) supporters of the idea that markets can reliably (prognosticate) the weather. A favourable season would not, by itself, (vindicate) the entire design. Nor should an unfavourable one automatically (relegate) every useful element of the scheme to the scrapheap.

Some arguments are settled less formally. A (posse) of campaigners meets at the riverside tavern, where a retired plumber cheerfully calls himself a (reprobate). They (carouse) while the cook prepares to (souse) herrings in vinegar. Alcohol is not the only substance that can (intoxicate): in the investment pavilion, projected returns are having a comparable effect.

At the launch, illuminated fountain droplets (coruscate), and the mayor offers (profuse) thanks to sponsors. A normally (sedate) resident begins to (grouse) about the spectacle. Repeated celebrations of water abundance can almost (nauseate) someone whose taps work only intermittently. Demonstrating reliable service would be a more persuasive form of promotion.

Officials need places where residents can (converse), (browse) proposed contracts and ask specific questions. Meetings will sometimes (divagate) into unrelated complaints. That is a manageable cost of participation. Nobody should have to (supplicate) before a councillor to obtain a service, and agencies should (communicate) decisions in language their users understand.

Saint Orin need not be (averse) to markets, nor should its leaders (deprecate) every objection as nostalgia. Reform may reduce waste without promising to (eradicate) scarcity. Government cannot (abdicate) responsibility for basic access, and its officials should (abnegate) privileges that undermine equal treatment. A successful water market would leave fewer residents dependent on knowing the right person.
translation:
一条河的价格
水务改革既要为稀缺定价，也要说清权力如何运作

本文以虚构小镇圣奥林为背景。

在圣奥林那座设有防御工事的修道院外，古老的(壕沟)已经干涸。一间废弃的(仓库)旁，工人正在费力处理一道生锈的(防洪闸门)。居民必须(穿过)狭窄的桥梁，才能越过(错综复杂的)运河网络回家。镇长提议通过水权交易所让一切实现现代化。维护团队则希望先获准订购一个替换铰链。

博物馆提供了历史视角。一枚代币的(正面)印着修道院院长的肖像，(背面)则是一座磨坊。这些代币的出现(早于)市政公用事业机构。那位院长是一名(独身的)管理者，后来被人们记作一位(隐士)，他既留下了账目，也留下了(诗作)。游客可以(沉思)他的优先事项：诗歌赞美天堂，账簿关心水权。

领先的镇长(候选人)是一位精力充沛的市场改革(倡导者)。她会(支持)竞争，寻求民众的(授权)，并乐于就效率问题(自以为是地高谈阔论)。她的核心论点是合理的：使用者消耗稀缺资源，应当承担一定成本。至于她的具体方案能否公平分配这种资源，则是另一个问题。

公共(钱袋)已经支撑着相当可观的(慷慨资助)。官员(发放)紧急援助，承诺为农民损坏的设备(报销补偿)，还向家庭提供节水(返款)。这些措施各有目的。把它们加总成一个令人印象深刻的支出数字，并不能说明哪些家庭得到了帮助，也不能说明用水量是否真的下降。

分配问题颇为棘手。支付能力与实际需求之间，可能存在(反向的)关系。统一涨价对贫困家庭可能造成尤其(不利的)后果，而给予有影响力企业的豁免，则会制造(适得其反的)激励。一项可行的方案必须(兼顾)一个(多样化的)人群，而不能让每一次分配都取决于政治关系。

工程提出的是另一类问题。两条相互垂直的渠道，可以通过沿三角形(斜边)铺设的管道连接起来。在别处，一条新渠道会在到达相互竞争的农场之前(分成两支)。地图能够(描绘)路线，并(划定)产权边界。但仅靠几何学，无法确定干旱期间谁的诉求应当优先。

公共(辩论)应当让这些选择清楚可见。然而，官方(话语)已经变得如此(深奥难懂)，以至于居民需要顾问来(详细解释)收费方案。一个简短的计算实例，比再来一份战略文件更能(阐明)其影响。如果改革的后果始终隐藏在术语背后，人们就无法真正知情地支持它。

利害关系远不止花园喷灌。果园可能(干枯)，工厂则需要可靠的系统来冷却机器、(润滑)运动部件。诊所需要稳定供水，以便工作人员为患者(用药治疗)或(输血)。对依靠歉收农田生活的家庭而言，担心的可能只是能否买得起一点可以(咀嚼)的东西。

农业学院教种植者如何(繁育)适宜的作物，并讲解牲畜(繁殖后代)所需的条件。其博物馆追溯人类(驯化)动植物的尝试。如今，教师也努力(灌输培养)合作习惯：共享设备的邻近农场，应当对获得的帮助作出(回报)。市场即将进入的，是一个原本就部分依靠相互义务维系的经济体系。

交易可以让使用者(汇集)零散的用水权益，或者(整合)经营活动。但陷入困境的农民，也可能为了支付眼前的账单，将一项宝贵的长期权利(变卖套现)。交易可以完全自愿，却仍让社区更难应对下一个艰难季节。它的后果，比完成了多少笔交易更值得关注。

干旱也不会消除洪水风险。暴雨可能(淹没)那些排水设施疏于维护的农田。闸门协调不当，可能(加剧)损失，并使家庭(流离失所)。这些相互作用会让改革(更加复杂)，但未必使其失败。不过，它们确实(否定)了一种便利的假设：高效定价能够替代对实体基础设施的管理。

有用的创新是可能的。一间实验室研究盐晶体如何在样品表面(形成晶核)，试验作物则把周围地块(点缀得色彩斑斓)。学院希望(孵化)本地企业，并(传播)实用知识。这些工作可以为改革(注入)对生产的关注。而这种关注，需要(渗透)到合同中，而不仅仅出现在会议演说里。

达成协议将是一件(需要谨慎处理的)事。仅仅为了(安抚)声音最大的反对者而提供补贴，可能会奖励阻挠行为。当政治(手腕)能够帮助(化解)真正的误解时，它就有价值。然而，眼下的(僵局)也反映了彼此不相容的利益。解决这些问题，需要对成本与权利作出明确决定，而不只是开展更好的宣传沟通。

每份合同都应包含清楚的(条款)，说明供水未能履约时，使用者有哪些(救济途径)。独立机构必须能够(裁决)争议。水表读数可能(显示)存在未经授权的引水，记录也可能(牵涉并指向)某个运营商。证据必须可以接受审查；一项指控不能仅仅因为出现在仪表盘上，就自动成为裁决。

一次审计已经促使议员(指控)一位前财务主管企图(侵吞)救济资金。他否认存在不当行为。现任政府既不应对缺失记录(支吾搪塞)，也不应对谁有责任提供记录(含糊其词)。技术复杂性不能成为(混淆)责任的手段。信任需要一种能够同时检验指控与否认的程序。

交易所的推动者坚持说，他们的提议并非(诡计)。但他们仍应(纠正)支持者的一种误解：市场能够可靠地(预测)天气。一个风调雨顺的季节，本身不足以(证明)整个设计正确。同样，一个不利的季节，也不应自动把方案中所有有用的部分都(贬入)废品堆。

一些争论以不那么正式的方式解决。一(队)活动人士在河边酒馆聚会，一名退休水管工在那里快活地自称(浪荡之徒)。他们(饮酒作乐)，厨师则准备把鲱鱼放进醋里(浸泡腌渍)。酒精并不是唯一能够使人(陶醉)的东西：在投资展馆里，预期收益正发挥着类似作用。

发布会上，灯光照耀的喷泉水珠(闪闪发光)，镇长向赞助商表达了(大量而热烈的)感谢。一位平日里(沉静的)居民开始对这场表演(发牢骚)。对于一个家中水龙头时断时续的人来说，反复庆祝水资源充裕，几乎会让他(感到恶心)。展示可靠的服务，会是一种更有说服力的宣传。

官员需要提供场所，让居民能够(交谈)、(浏览)拟议合同，并提出具体问题。会议有时会(离题)，转向无关的抱怨。这是公众参与中可以承受的成本。任何人都不应为了获得服务，而在议员面前(哀求)，各机构也应当用使用者能够理解的语言(传达)决定。

圣奥林不必(反感)市场，其领导者也不应把每一种反对意见都当作怀旧情绪而加以(贬斥)。改革可以减少浪费，而不必承诺(根除)稀缺。政府不能(放弃)保障基本用水的责任，官员也应当(舍弃)那些破坏平等待遇的特权。一个成功的水权市场，会让更少的居民依赖于认识某个有门路的人。

本批词根亮点：

• -verse/-vert 大家族：averse/adverse/diverse/inverse/perverse/reverse/traverse/converse，全来自拉丁 vertere（转），前缀决定转向方向

• -fuse 大家族：defuse/diffuse/infuse/profuse/transfuse，全来自拉丁 fundere（浇/倒），infuse=浇入，transfuse=跨越浇=输血

• -cate 大家族（本批核心）：eradicate/abdicate/vindicate/placate/implicate/complicate/intricate，全来自拉丁 -care（做）或特定词根，-cate 是使役动词常见后缀

• eradicate：e（向外）+ radic（根，拉丁radix），连根拔出=根除，radical（根本的）/radish（萝卜）同根

• candidate：拉丁 candidatus（穿白袍的人），古罗马候选人穿白色托加袍=纯洁/无罪，candid（坦诚=白色）同根

• pontificate：pontifex（教皇/主教=桥的建造者），pontificate=像教皇一样发表权威意见，pont（桥）/ponytail（马尾辫）同根

• inculcate：in+calcare（踩踏），把知识踩进去=灌输，calculus（微积分=小石子）同根

• prevaricate：pre+varicare（叉开腿走路），左摇右摆=支吾其词，prevarication拐弯抹角

quiz.question: _____ verse
quiz.explanation: 诗句，无韵诗。Shakespeare wrote in blank verse. 莎士比亚用无韵诗写作。 | vers->转向（拉丁vertere），verse->转行的文字=诗句（cf. version版本，invert颠倒，convert转变，anniversary周年=转回同一天） || 文化联想：唐诗里一行一行整齐排列的诗句最适合帮助记忆 verse，可以说 **a verse from a Tang poem — “A single verse from a Tang poem can carry a complete image of moonlight, mountains, or homesickness in only a few words.”**

quiz.question: averse __ ____
quiz.explanation: 反对的，反对风险。Investors are averse to risk. 投资者反对风险。 | a->朝向/对抗，vers->转（拉丁），averse->转向反对=厌恶（cf. adverse不利，aversion厌恶，version版本，convert转变） || 文化联想：“一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳”最适合帮助记忆 averse，可以说 **become averse to risk — “After one painful loss, a person may become averse to risk, just like someone who fears even a rope after once being bitten by a snake.”**

quiz.question: traverse ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 穿越，穿越沙漠。They had to traverse the desert. 他们不得不穿越沙漠。 | tra->横过，vers->转，traverse->横向穿越（cf. transverse横向，controversy争论=相互转，divert转移，adversity逆境） || 文化联想：丝绸之路商队穿过戈壁和沙漠的画面最适合联想到 traverse，可以说 **traverse the desert — “Caravans on the Silk Road had to traverse long stretches of desert before reaching the next oasis.”**

quiz.question: ____'_ obverse
quiz.explanation: 正面，硬币的正面。The coin's obverse shows the president. 硬币的正面显示总统。 | ob->朝向，vers->转，obverse->面向观者的一面=正面（cf. reverse反面，converse交谈，adverse不利，inverse反向） || 文化联想：古钱币正面通常铸有年号或钱文，这一面最适合帮助记忆 obverse，可以说 **the obverse of a coin — “On many traditional Chinese cash coins, the obverse bears the main inscription around the central square hole.”**

quiz.question: adverse ______
quiz.explanation: 不利的，不利的影响。The drug had an adverse effect. 这种药物有不利的影响。 | ad->朝向，vers->转，adverse->转向对抗=不利的（cf. adversity逆境，averse厌恶，adversary对手，advertise广告=转向注意） || 文化联想：中文“是药三分毒”提醒人们药物也可能带来不良影响，最适合联想到 adverse，可以说 **an adverse effect — “The saying ‘every medicine has some toxicity’ is a reminder that even useful treatment can have an adverse effect.”**

quiz.question: reverse ____
quiz.explanation: 倒退，倒档。Put the car in reverse gear. 把车挂倒档。 | re->向后，vers->转，reverse->向后转=倒退（cf. revert恢复，irreversible不可逆，reversible可逆，obverse正面） || 文化联想：中国驾考里的“倒车入库”最适合帮助记忆 reverse，可以说 **reverse gear — “During the driving test, a learner must shift into reverse gear before backing carefully into the parking space.”**

quiz.question: diverse ________
quiz.explanation: 多样的，多样的观众。The show attracted a diverse audience. 演出吸引了多样的观众。 | di->分开，vers->转，diverse->向不同方向转=多样的（cf. divert转移，diversity多样性，diverge分歧，diversion转移） || 文化联想：春节庙会上老人、孩子、游客和摊贩混在一起，最适合联想到 diverse，可以说 **a diverse crowd — “A major temple fair attracts a diverse crowd of families, tourists, performers, vendors, and elderly local residents.”**

quiz.question: inverse ________
quiz.explanation: 逆向的，逆向函数。Calculate the inverse function. 计算逆向函数。 | in->向内，vers->转，inverse->向内转=逆向的（cf. invert颠倒，converse相反，reverse逆转，perverse乖张） || 文化联想：中国中学数学课里求反函数是非常熟悉的训练，最适合帮助记忆 inverse，可以说 **an inverse function — “In a high-school math class, students learn that an inverse function reverses the mapping performed by the original function.”**

quiz.question: ______ converse
quiz.explanation: 交谈，随意交谈。They engaged in casual converse. 他们进行随意交谈。 | con->共同，vers->转，converse->共同转=交流（cf. conversation对话，convert转变，controversial争议，universe宇宙=转向统一） || 文化联想：老茶馆里客人边喝茶边闲聊最适合联想到 converse，可以说 **casual converse — “In an old Chengdu teahouse, customers may spend an afternoon in casual converse over cups of tea.”**

quiz.question: perverse ________
quiz.explanation: 乖张的，乖张的行为。His perverse behavior was troubling. 他乖张的行为令人不安。 | per->彻底，vers->转，perverse->彻底转离正途=乖张的（cf. pervert歪曲，perverted扭曲，invert颠倒，adverse不利） || 文化联想：中文“倒行逆施”最适合帮助记忆 perverse，可以说 **perverse behavior — “Someone who deliberately acts against reason and accepted norms may be condemned for perverse behavior—‘倒行逆施.’”**

quiz.question: reimburse ________
quiz.explanation: 报销，报销费用。The company will reimburse expenses. 公司会报销费用。 | re->再次，im->进入，burs->钱包（拉丁bursa），reimburse->把钱再放回钱包=报销（cf. bursar财务主管，bursary奖学金，disburse支付） || 文化联想：中国公司员工出差后拿发票报销交通和住宿费，最适合联想到 reimburse，可以说 **reimburse travel expenses — “After a business trip, a company may reimburse an employee’s train fare, hotel bill, and other approved expenses.”**

quiz.question: disburse _____
quiz.explanation: 支付，支付资金。The treasurer would disburse funds. 财务主管会支付资金。 | dis->分开，burs->钱包，disburse->从钱包里分出=支付（cf. reimburse报销，bursar财务，purse钱包，bursary奖学金） || 文化联想：灾荒时官府开仓发放粮食和赈济款，最适合帮助记忆 disburse，可以说 **disburse relief funds — “During a famine, local authorities might disburse relief funds and grain to families in urgent need.”**

quiz.question: ____ recourse

quiz.explanation: 表明，表明趋势。The data indicate a trend. 数据表明趋势。 | in->向，dic->说/指（拉丁dicere），indicate->指向=表明（cf. indicate指出，index指数，indict起诉，dictate命令，predict预测） || 文化联想：“一叶知秋”最适合帮助记忆 indicate，因为一个小迹象可以表明更大的趋势，可以说 **indicate a trend — “A single falling leaf may indicate a broader trend toward autumn, as the saying ‘一叶知秋’ suggests.”**

quiz.question: vindicate ______
quiz.explanation: 证明正当，证明权利正当。The ruling would vindicate rights. 裁决会证明权利正当。 | vind->索赔/维护（拉丁vindicare），icate->使，vindicate->维护正当（cf. avenge复仇，vengeance复仇，vindictive报复性，avindicate辩护） || 文化联想：包公断案的民间形象常是替受冤者主持公道，最适合联想到 vindicate，可以说 **vindicate someone’s rights — “In popular stories, Bao Zheng exposes wrongdoing and vindicates the rights of people who have been treated unjustly.”**

quiz.question: adjudicate _______
quiz.explanation: 裁决，裁决争端。The court will adjudicate dispute. 法院将裁决争端。 | ad->朝向，judic->判断（拉丁judex->法官），adjudicate->朝向法官=裁决（cf. judge法官，judicial司法，prejudice偏见，injudicious不明智） || 文化联想：古代县衙由县令审理田产、债务等纠纷，最适合联想到 adjudicate，可以说 **adjudicate a dispute — “A county magistrate might adjudicate a dispute over land boundaries after hearing both sides and examining documents.”**

quiz.question: pontificate _________
quiz.explanation: 武断地说教，傲慢地武断地说教。He would pontificate pompously. 他会傲慢地武断地说教。 | pontifex->桥的建造者（拉丁pons+facere），教皇=最高祭司=桥的建造者，pontificate->像教皇一样发话（cf. pont桥，pontoon浮桥，Ponte Vecchio老桥） || 文化联想：中文“老学究高谈阔论”很适合帮助记忆 pontificate，可以说 **pontificate pompously — “An old scholar who talks as if only he understands the classics may pontificate pompously for hours.”**

quiz.question: delicate _______
quiz.explanation: 微妙的，微妙的平衡。Maintain a delicate balance. 保持微妙的平衡。 | delic->引诱（拉丁delicatus->享乐的），delicate->令人享乐的=精致微妙的（cf. delicious美味，delight喜悦，delicacy美味/微妙） || 文化联想：阴阳相济、彼此制约的思想最适合帮助记忆 delicate，可以说 **a delicate balance — “The yin-yang image suggests a delicate balance in which opposing forces remain different yet mutually dependent.”**

quiz.question: implicate __ _____
quiz.explanation: 牵连，牵连欺诈。Evidence would implicate him in fraud. 证据会让他牵连欺诈。 | im->进入，plic->折叠（拉丁plicare），implicate->折叠进去=牵涉其中（cf. complicate使复杂，explicit明确，duplicate复制，implication含义） || 文化联想：“顺藤摸瓜”查案时常会牵出更多涉案者，很适合联想到 implicate，可以说 **implicate someone in corruption — “Following the money trail may uncover records that implicate additional officials in a corruption case.”**

quiz.question: complicate ______
quiz.explanation: 使复杂化，使事情复杂化。Don't complicate matter further. 不要进一步使事情复杂化。 | com->共同，plic->折叠，complicate->折叠在一起=使复杂（cf. implicate牵涉，explicit明确，intricate复杂，duplicate复制） || 文化联想：中文“节外生枝”最适合帮助记忆 complicate，可以说 **complicate the matter — “Adding a new quarrel to an already difficult dispute can complicate the matter—‘节外生枝.’”**

quiz.question: supplicate ___
quiz.explanation: 恳求，恳求上帝。They would supplicate God for mercy. 他们会恳求上帝宽恕。 | sup->在下，plic->折叠（拉丁），supplicate->跪倒折叠=恳求（cf. supple柔软，comply遵守，supplication恳求，humble谦卑=跪倒） || 文化联想：民间遇到大旱时会举行祈雨仪式、向神灵恳求降雨，很适合联想到 supplicate，可以说 **supplicate a deity for rain — “During a severe drought, villagers in an old folk tale might supplicate a deity for rain.”**

quiz.question: explicate _ ______
quiz.explanation: 阐明，阐明理论。The professor would explicate a theory. 教授会阐明理论。 | ex->向外，plic->折叠，explicate->展开折叠=阐明（cf. explain解释，explicit明确，complicate复杂，implicate牵涉，duplicate复制） || 文化联想：老师把阴阳五行或古代哲学概念一层层讲明白，最适合联想到 explicate，可以说 **explicate a theory — “A skilled teacher can explicate a difficult classical theory by unpacking its terms and examples step by step.”**

quiz.question: communicate _______
quiz.explanation: 沟通，清楚地沟通。Always communicate clearly. 始终清楚地沟通。 | com->共同，mun->服务（拉丁munus），communicate->共同分享=沟通（cf. community社区，commune公社，immunity免疫，municipal市政） || 文化联想：中文“有话直说、把话说明白”最适合帮助记忆 communicate，可以说 **communicate clearly — “In a difficult family discussion, it is better to communicate clearly than to rely on hints and guesswork.”**

quiz.question: prevaricate __ _____
quiz.explanation: 支吾其词，在回答中支吾其词。Don't prevaricate in reply. 不要在回答中支吾其词。 | pre->提前，varic->叉开腿（拉丁varicare），prevaricate->叉开腿走路=拐弯抹角（cf. varicose静脉曲张=叉开的，prevarication支吾，equivocate含糊） || 文化联想：孟子“王顾左右而言他”就是被问到关键问题时故意支吾其词，最适合联想到 prevaricate，可以说 **prevaricate in reply — “When pressed with an uncomfortable question, someone who ‘looks left and right and talks of other things’ begins to prevaricate in reply.”**

quiz.question: lubricate _____
quiz.explanation: 润滑，润滑齿轮。Regularly lubricate gears. 定期润滑齿轮。 | lubric->滑（拉丁lubricus->滑），lubricate->使滑=润滑（cf. lubricious轻浮/滑溜，lubricant润滑剂，slippery滑，lubrication润滑） || 文化联想：农村旧式脱粒机、磨面机的齿轮需要定期上油，最适合联想到 lubricate，可以说 **lubricate the gears — “Before using an old farm machine, a mechanic may lubricate the gears so they turn smoothly.”**

quiz.question: intricate _______
quiz.explanation: 复杂的，复杂的图案。The carpet had an intricate pattern. 地毯有复杂的图案。 | in->进入，tric->障碍（拉丁tricae->纠纷），intricate->充满内部障碍的=复杂的（cf. extricate解脱，intricacy复杂，complicated复杂） || 文化联想：南京云锦和苏绣里层层交织的纹样最适合帮助记忆 intricate，可以说 **an intricate pattern — “A piece of Nanjing brocade may contain an intricate pattern of clouds, flowers, birds, and geometric forms.”**

quiz.question: masticate ____
quiz.explanation: 咀嚼，咀嚼食物。Chew and masticate food thoroughly. 充分咀嚼食物。 | masticare->咀嚼（拉丁，来自希腊masasthai），masticate->用臼齿咀嚼（cf. mastic乳香脂，masticate咀嚼，molar臼齿，jaw下巴） || 文化联想：中文“细嚼慢咽”最适合帮助记忆 masticate，可以说 **masticate food thoroughly — “The advice ‘细嚼慢咽’ encourages people to masticate food thoroughly instead of swallowing too quickly.”**

quiz.question: domesticate _______
quiz.explanation: 驯养，驯养动物。Humans learned to domesticate animals. 人类学会了驯养动物。 | domus->家（拉丁），domesticate->使成为家里的=驯养（cf. domestic家庭，domicile住所，dome穹顶，major-domo大总管） || 文化联想：中国古代农业社会很早就驯养猪、狗、牛等家畜，最适合联想到 domesticate，可以说 **domesticate animals — “Early farming communities in China learned to domesticate animals such as pigs and dogs for food, labor, and companionship.”**

quiz.question: prognosticate ____
quiz.explanation: 预言，预言厄运。Prophets would prognosticate doom. 先知会预言厄运。 | pro->向前，gnos->知道（希腊），ticate->使，prognosticate->提前知道=预言（cf. prognosis预后，diagnosis诊断，agnostic不可知，cognition认知） || 文化联想：古代观天象、占吉凶的术士常会预言灾祸，最适合联想到 prognosticate，可以说 **prognosticate doom — “A court astrologer who saw an ominous celestial sign might prognosticate doom for the coming year.”**

quiz.question: intoxicate ____ ____
quiz.explanation: 使陶醉，用酒使陶醉。Don't intoxicate with wine. 不要用酒使陶醉。 | in->进入，toxic->毒（希腊toxikon->毒药），intoxicate->注入毒素=使陶醉（cf. toxic毒性，antidote解毒剂，toxin毒素，detoxify解毒） || 文化联想：李白与酒的文学形象很适合帮助记忆 intoxicate，可以说 **be intoxicated with wine — “In poems and legends surrounding Li Bai, wine can intoxicate the poet and loosen a flood of imaginative verse.”**

quiz.question: defalcate _____
quiz.explanation: 挪用公款，挪用公款资金。The accountant would defalcate funds. 会计会挪用公款资金。 | de->去除，falc->镰刀（拉丁falx），defalcate->用镰刀割走=侵吞（cf. falcon猎鹰=镰刀形爪，falcate镰刀形，embezzle挪用，misappropriate） || 文化联想：贪官侵吞赈灾银两最适合帮助记忆 defalcate，可以说 **defalcate public funds — “A corrupt official who secretly diverts relief money into his own pocket may defalcate public funds.”**

quiz.question: inculcate ______
quiz.explanation: 灌输，灌输价值观。Parents inculcate values in children. 父母给孩子灌输价值观。 | in->进入，culc->踩（拉丁calcare->踩），inculcate->踩进去=灌输（cf. calculus微积分=小石子，calculate计算，calcium钙=石灰） || 文化联想：《朱子家训》这类家训反复教导勤俭、孝悌等价值，最适合联想到 inculcate，可以说 **inculcate family values — “A traditional family precept may repeatedly inculcate values such as thrift, respect for elders, and responsibility.”**

quiz.question: dislocate ________
quiz.explanation: 使脱臼，使肩膀脱臼。The fall would dislocate shoulder. 跌倒会使肩膀脱臼。 | dis->分开，loc->地方（拉丁locus），dislocate->使离开原位=脱臼（cf. locate定位，location位置，locus焦点，relocate重新定位） || 文化联想：舞狮或武术训练中跌倒造成肩关节脱臼的场景很适合联想到 dislocate，可以说 **dislocate a shoulder — “A bad fall during martial-arts practice can dislocate a shoulder and require medical treatment.”**

quiz.question: reciprocate ________
quiz.explanation: 回报，回报善意。She would reciprocate kindness. 她会回报善意。 | reciproc->来回（拉丁reciprocus->来回），reciprocate->来回=回报（cf. reciprocal互惠，reciprocity互惠，mutual相互，bilateral双边） || 文化联想：“滴水之恩，当涌泉相报”最适合帮助记忆 reciprocate，可以说 **reciprocate a kindness — “The saying ‘repay a drop of kindness with a gushing spring’ urges people to reciprocate a kindness generously.”**

quiz.question: ______ advocate
quiz.explanation: 倡导者，公众倡导者。He became a public advocate. 他成为公众倡导者。 | ad->朝向，voc->声音（拉丁vocare），advocate->呼唤支持=倡导者（cf. vocal声音，invoke调用，evoke唤起，provoke激怒，vocation职业） || 文化联想：戊戌变法时期公开鼓吹改革的知识分子很适合联想到 advocate，可以说 **a public advocate for reform — “A late-Qing intellectual who wrote essays and petitions for institutional change could become a public advocate for reform.”**

quiz.question: equivocate __
quiz.explanation: 含糊其辞，对...含糊其辞。Don't equivocate on the issue. 不要对这个问题含糊其辞。 | equi->相等，voc->声音（拉丁），equivocate->两种声音都相等=含糊其辞（cf. equivocal模棱两可，ambiguous模糊，prevaricate支吾） || 文化联想：中文“模棱两可”最适合帮助记忆 equivocate，可以说 **equivocate on the issue — “A speaker who refuses to say yes or no and keeps both meanings open may equivocate on the issue.”**

quiz.question: demarcate ________
quiz.explanation: 划定界限，划定界限边界。The treaty would demarcate boundary. 条约会划定界限边界。 | de->彻底，marc->标记（法语marque），demarcate->彻底标记=划定（cf. mark标记，remark评论，remarkable值得注意，landmark地标） || 文化联想：古代村界、县界常用界碑标出范围，最适合帮助记忆 demarcate，可以说 **demarcate a boundary — “A stone marker placed between two villages can demarcate a boundary and reduce future disputes.”**

quiz.question: bifurcate ____
quiz.explanation: 分叉，分叉成。The road would bifurcate into two paths. 道路会分叉成两条路。 | bi->二，furc->叉（拉丁furca），bifurcate->分成两叉（cf. fork叉子，bifurcation分叉，binary二进制，binocular双目镜） || 文化联想：都江堰等灌溉系统把水流分到不同渠道的画面很适合联想到 bifurcate，可以说 **bifurcate into two channels — “At a diversion point, an irrigation stream may bifurcate into two channels serving different fields.”**

quiz.question: obfuscate ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 使混淆，使问题混淆。Don't obfuscate the issue. 不要使问题混淆。 | ob->使，fusc->暗（拉丁fuscus->深色），obfuscate->使变暗=混淆（cf. fuscous深褐色，obscure晦涩，confuse混淆，bewilder困惑） || 文化联想：中文“混淆视听”最适合帮助记忆 obfuscate，可以说 **obfuscate the issue — “Flooding a debate with irrelevant rumors can obfuscate the issue—‘混淆视听.’”**

quiz.question: coruscate ____ ___
quiz.explanation: 闪耀，以机智闪耀。His remarks would coruscate with wit. 他的言论会以机智闪耀。 | corusc->闪光（拉丁coruscare->闪光），coruscate->闪闪发光（cf. oscillate振荡，scintillate闪烁，iridescent彩虹色，glitter闪光） || 文化联想：相声演员“妙语连珠”、一句接一句闪着机智火花的状态很适合联想到 coruscate，可以说 **coruscate with wit — “A brilliant xiangsheng performer can coruscate with wit, producing one sharp line after another.”**

quiz.question: sedate ______
quiz.explanation: 沉着的，沉着的举止。He had a sedate manner. 他有沉着的举止。 | sed->坐（拉丁sedere），sedate->坐着不动的=沉着的（cf. sediment沉积，preside主持，reside居住，sedentary久坐，assess评估） || 文化联想：中文“温文尔雅”最适合帮助记忆 sedate，可以说 **a sedate manner — “A scholar described as ‘温文尔雅’ speaks and moves in a calm, sedate manner.”**

quiz.question: antedate ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 早于，早于事件。These ruins antedate the event. 这些遗迹早于事件。 | ante->之前，dat->日期（拉丁datum），antedate->日期在之前=早于（cf. date日期，postdate晚于，update更新，antecedent先例） || 文化联想：甲骨文远早于秦代小篆，是 antedate 最直观的中国历史联想之一，可以说 **antedate a later script — “Oracle-bone inscriptions antedate the standardized small-seal script of the Qin period by many centuries.”**

quiz.question: elucidate _______
quiz.explanation: 阐明，阐明概念。Let me elucidate concept further. 让我进一步阐明概念。 | e->向外，lucid->光（拉丁lux），elucidate->带出光明=阐明（cf. lucid清晰，translucent半透明，illuminate照亮，pellucid清澈） || 文化联想：中文“深入浅出”最适合帮助记忆 elucidate，可以说 **elucidate a difficult concept — “A good teacher can elucidate a difficult classical idea by explaining it in simple language and concrete examples.”**

quiz.question: _________ candidate
quiz.explanation: 候选人，政治候选人。The political candidate campaigned hard. 政治候选人努力竞选。 | candidatus->穿白袍的（拉丁candidus->白色），candidate->穿白袍的候选人（cf. candid坦诚=白色，incandescent白炽，candle蜡烛） || 文化联想：科举考场里每个参加考试的士子都是 candidate，可以说 **an examination candidate — “An examination candidate in the imperial era might spend days inside a tiny cell completing the required essays.”**

quiz.question: consolidate _____
quiz.explanation: 巩固，巩固权力。The leader would consolidate power. 领导者会巩固权力。 | con->共同，solid->固（拉丁solidus），consolidate->使共同坚固=巩固（cf. solid固体，solidarity团结，solidify固化，solidity坚固） || 文化联想：秦统一六国后进一步集中制度和行政权力，很适合联想到 consolidate，可以说 **consolidate imperial power — “After unification, the Qin court moved to consolidate imperial power through standardized administration and direct control.”**

quiz.question: liquidate ______
quiz.explanation: 清算，清算资产。The company had to liquidate assets. 公司不得不清算资产。 | liquid->液体（拉丁liquidus），ate->使，liquidate->使变成流动性=清算（cf. liquid流动，liquor酒，liquify液化，liquidation清算） || 文化联想：老字号商号倒闭清算时往往要变卖库存和房产，最适合联想到 liquidate，可以说 **liquidate assets — “When a merchant house failed, its owners might have to liquidate assets to repay creditors.”**

quiz.question: __________ mandate
quiz.explanation: 授权，政府授权。The government mandate was clear. 政府授权很明确。 | man->手（拉丁manus），dat->给（拉丁dare），mandate->手交出去=授权（cf. command命令，demand要求，remand羁押，reprimand训斥） || 文化联想：皇帝通过诏令明确要求地方官执行某项命令，可以帮助记忆 mandate，可以说 **an imperial mandate — “An imperial edict could serve as a mandate requiring local officials to carry out a specified policy.”**

quiz.question: inundate ____ ________
quiz.explanation: 淹没，被请求淹没。They would inundate with requests. 他们会被请求淹没。 | in->进入，und->波浪（拉丁unda），inundate->波浪涌入=淹没（cf. undulate波动，abound充满，redund多余，abundant充足） || 文化联想：春节前政务热线、铁路客服或售票平台可能一下收到大量咨询，最适合联想到 inundate，可以说 **be inundated with requests — “Before the Spring Festival travel rush, a service center may be inundated with requests for ticket changes and travel information.”**

quiz.question: accommodate _____
quiz.explanation: 容纳，容纳需求。We can accommodate needs. 我们可以容纳需求。 | ac->使，commod->合适（拉丁commodus），accommodate->使合适=容纳（cf. commodity商品，commodious宽敞，mode模式，modify修改） || 文化联想：中国家庭宴席常会照顾老人、儿童、素食者等不同饮食需求，很适合联想到 accommodate，可以说 **accommodate different needs — “A thoughtful family banquet can accommodate different needs by offering softer dishes, vegetarian choices, and less spicy food.”**

quiz.question: nucleate _______
quiz.explanation: 成核，成核沸腾。Nucleate boiling occurs in the pot. 成核沸腾在锅中发生。 | nucle->核（拉丁nucleus->果核），ate->形成，nucleate->形成核心（cf. nucleus核，nuclear核的，nucleic核的，denuclearize去核化） || 文化联想：煮茶时锅底细小划痕处最先冒出气泡，最适合帮助记忆 nucleate，可以说 **nucleate boiling bubbles — “When water is heated for tea, tiny surface imperfections can nucleate boiling bubbles before the water reaches a full rolling boil.”**

quiz.question: permeate ___ ___
quiz.explanation: 渗透，渗透空气。The scent would permeate the air. 香味会渗透空气。 | per->彻底，me->过（拉丁meare->流过），permeate->彻底流过=渗透（cf. permeable可渗透，impermeable不透，semipermeable半透） || 文化联想：桂花开时香气能弥漫整条小巷，最适合联想到 permeate，可以说 **permeate the air — “In autumn, the fragrance of osmanthus can permeate the air around a Jiangnan courtyard.”**

quiz.question: delineate __________
quiz.explanation: 描绘，描绘边界。Clearly delineate boundaries. 清楚地描绘边界。 | de->彻底，line->线（拉丁linea），delineate->用线彻底描绘（cf. line线，linear线性，outline轮廓，underline下划线，lineage血统） || 文化联想：古代界碑、城墙和河道常被用来明确行政边界，最适合联想到 delineate，可以说 **delineate boundaries — “Maps, rivers, and stone markers were used to delineate boundaries between neighboring districts.”**

quiz.question: procreate _______
quiz.explanation: 繁殖，快速繁殖。Some species procreate quickly. 一些物种快速繁殖。 | pro->向前，cre->创造（拉丁creare），procreate->向前创造=繁殖（cf. create创造，recreate娱乐，procreation繁殖，creature生物） || 文化联想：乡村养兔时如果不控制繁殖数量，兔群会很快增加，最适合联想到 procreate，可以说 **procreate quickly — “A pair of rabbits can procreate quickly, so a small breeding enclosure may soon become crowded.”**

quiz.question: divagate ____ _____

quiz.question: ____ floodgate
quiz.explanation: 水闸，打开水闸。This decision will open floodgate. 这个决定会打开水闸。 | flood->洪水，gate->门，floodgate->控制洪水的门=水闸（cf. flood洪水，gate门，watergate水闸/水门事件，floodgate打开先例） || 文化联想：都江堰等水利工程通过闸门调节和分配水流，最适合帮助记忆 floodgate，可以说 **open the floodgate — “During irrigation, workers may open the floodgate to release more water into a channel.”**

quiz.question: variegate ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 使多样化，使花园多样化。Various flowers variegate the garden. 各种花使花园多样化。 | vari->变化（拉丁varius），gate->使，variegate->使多样化（cf. various各种，vary变化，variety多样，variable变量，variegated多色的） || 文化联想：苏州园林利用竹、芭蕉、花木和四季色彩让景观层次不断变化，很适合联想到 variegate，可以说 **variegate the garden — “Seasonal flowers, bamboo, and changing foliage variegate the garden with different colors and textures throughout the year.”**

quiz.question: relegate __ _______

quiz.question: negate ________

quiz.question: abnegate ____
quiz.explanation: 放弃，放弃自我。Saints would abnegate self. 圣人会放弃自我。 | ab->离开，neg->否认，abnegate->否认离开=放弃（cf. negate否定，deny否认，renounce放弃，abdicate退位，self-denial自我否定） || 文化联想：儒家“克己复礼”强调克制私欲、约束自我，最适合帮助记忆 abnegate，可以说 **abnegate the self — “The ideal of ‘克己复礼’ asks a person to restrain private desire and, in that sense, abnegate the self for a larger moral order.”**

quiz.question: aggregate ______
quiz.explanation: 总计，总需求。Economists study aggregate demand. 经济学家研究总需求。 | ag->朝向，greg->群（拉丁grex），aggregate->聚集成群=总计（cf. congregate集合，segregate隔离，gregarious爱交际，egregious极端的=离群的） || 文化联想：古代地方官把各县粮食产量汇总成总数上报朝廷，很适合联想到 aggregate，可以说 **aggregate local data — “Officials could aggregate local grain figures from many counties to estimate the total harvest of a province.”**

quiz.question: fumigate _____

quiz.question: mitigate ____
quiz.explanation: 减轻，减轻风险。The company implemented new safety protocols to mitigate risk. 公司实施了新的安全规程以减轻风险。 | mit->温和（拉丁mitis->温和），gate->使，mitigate->使温和=减轻（cf. mild温和，mitigate缓和，unmitigated没有减轻的，mitigation缓解） || 文化联想：古代治河时修堤、分洪来降低水患风险，最适合联想到 mitigate，可以说 **mitigate flood risk — “Building levees and diversion channels can help mitigate flood risk along a major river.”**

quiz.question: castigate __________
quiz.explanation: 严厉批评，严厉批评腐败。The editorial continued to castigate corruption among high-ranking officials. 这篇社论继续严厉批评高级官员中的腐败。 | caste->纯洁（拉丁castus），gate->使，castigate->使变纯洁=惩戒（cf. chaste纯洁，chastise惩戒，chastity贞洁，castigate严厉批评） || 文化联想：御史上奏弹劾贪官、严厉斥责腐败最适合帮助记忆 castigate，可以说 **castigate corruption — “An imperial censor might use a memorial to castigate corruption among powerful officials.”**

quiz.question: instigate ________

quiz.question: promulgate ___

quiz.question: subjugate _ ______

quiz.question: emaciate ___ ____

quiz.question: depreciate ______

quiz.question: enunciate _______

quiz.question: denunciate __________

quiz.question: renunciate _______ _______

quiz.question: associate _________

quiz.question: dissociate _______

quiz.question: mediate ________

quiz.question: repudiate _____

quiz.question: ciliate ________
quiz.explanation: 有纤毛的，有纤毛的原生动物。Under the microscope, we observed ciliate protozoa moving through the water sample. 在显微镜下我们观察到有纤毛的原生动物在水样中移动。 | cili->睫毛（拉丁cilium），ciliate->有纤毛的（cf. cilium纤毛，ciliary睫状体，supercilious傲慢=眉毛高扬，eyelash睫毛） || 文化联想：中学生物课观察草履虫时能看到表面密布纤毛，最适合帮助记忆 ciliate，可以说 **a ciliate protozoan — “Under a microscope, a paramecium is a ciliate protozoan covered with tiny hairs that help it move through water.”**

quiz.question: conciliate _________
quiz.explanation: 安抚，安抚对手。The leader's strategy was to conciliate opponents rather than confront them. 领导者的策略是安抚对手而不是直接对抗。 | con->共同，cili->议会（拉丁concilium），conciliate->召开议会和解=安抚（cf. council议会，reconcile和解，irreconcilable不可调和，conciliation安抚） || 文化联想：“以和为贵”最适合帮助记忆 conciliate，可以说 **conciliate an opponent — “A negotiator who values harmony may offer concessions to conciliate an opponent rather than prolong the quarrel.”**

quiz.question: affiliate _______
quiz.explanation: 附属，附属项目。The university launched an affiliate program with several international institutions. 该大学与国际机构启动了附属项目。 | af->朝向，fili->儿子（拉丁filius），affiliate->收为儿子=使附属（cf. filial孝顺，filicide杀子，filiation血统，affiliate联盟成员） || 文化联想：中国大学与附属医院、附属中学的关系最适合帮助记忆 affiliate，可以说 **an affiliated institution — “A university hospital may be an affiliated institution that shares teaching, research, and training programs with the university.”**

quiz.question: palliate ________
quiz.explanation: 缓解，缓解症状。The medication can only palliate symptoms but not cure the disease. 这种药物只能缓解症状但不能治愈疾病。 | palli->披风（拉丁pallium），palliate->用披风覆盖=掩盖/缓解（cf. palliative缓解性的，pallor苍白，cloak掩盖，palliative care姑息治疗） || 文化联想：中医里有些药只能缓解疼痛、咳嗽等症状，并不能治本，很适合联想到 palliate，可以说 **palliate the symptoms — “A remedy may palliate the symptoms and make a patient more comfortable even if it does not cure the underlying illness.”**

quiz.question: defoliate ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 使落叶，使树木落叶。The chemical agent was designed to defoliate the trees in enemy territory. 这种化学制剂旨在使敌方领土上的树木落叶。 | de->去除，foli->叶子（拉丁folium），defoliate->使叶子脱落（cf. foliage叶子，folio对折纸，portfolio作品集，defoliation落叶） || 文化联想：秋风或虫害让树木大片落叶的场景很适合联想到 defoliate，可以说 **defoliate the trees — “A severe caterpillar outbreak can defoliate the trees until their branches are almost bare.”**

quiz.question: calumniate _ _____
quiz.explanation: 诽谤，诽谤对手。It is unethical to calumniate a rival in order to gain political advantage. 为了政治优势而诽谤对手是不道德的。 | calumni->诽谤（拉丁calumnia），calumniate->故意诽谤（cf. calumny诽谤，calumnious诽谤性的，slander诽谤，defame损毁名誉） || 文化联想：古代奸臣用谗言中伤忠臣最适合帮助记忆 calumniate，可以说 **calumniate a rival — “A scheming courtier might calumniate a rival by spreading false accusations to ruin his reputation.”**

quiz.question: opiate ________
quiz.explanation: 鸦片类药物，鸦片类药物过量。Emergency rooms have seen a dramatic increase in opiate overdose cases. 急诊室看到鸦片类药物过量病例急剧增加。 | opium->鸦片（希腊opos->汁液），opiate->鸦片制剂（cf. opium鸦片，opioid类鸦片，overdose过量，morphine吗啡=Morpheus睡眠之神） || 文化联想：鸦片战争和晚清鸦片问题最适合帮助记忆 opiate，可以说 **opiate addiction — “The spread of opiate addiction became a major social and political concern in nineteenth-century China.”**

quiz.question: expiate _____
quiz.explanation: 赎罪，赎罪。He spent years trying to expiate guilt over his past mistakes. 他花了多年时间为过去的错误赎罪。 | ex->向外，pi->虔诚（拉丁pius），expiate->通过虔诚行为清除罪孽=赎罪（cf. piety虔诚，pious虔诚，impious不虔诚，expiation赎罪） || 文化联想：廉颇“负荆请罪”主动认错并弥补过失，最适合联想到 expiate，可以说 **expiate one’s guilt — “By humbling himself and asking Lin Xiangru for forgiveness, Lian Po sought to expiate his guilt.”**

quiz.question: inebriate ______
quiz.explanation: 醉酒的，醉酒的司机。Police arrested an inebriate driver after a routine traffic stop. 警方在例行交通检查后逮捕了醉酒的司机。 | in->使，ebri->醉（拉丁ebrius->醉），inebriate->使醉=醉酒的（cf. inebriated醉酒，sobriety清醒，sober清醒，temperance节制） || 文化联想：酒驾查处是中国人很熟悉的现代场景，最适合联想到 inebriate，可以说 **an inebriate driver — “Police may stop an inebriate driver whose alcohol level makes it unsafe and illegal to remain on the road.”**

quiz.question: excoriate ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 严厉批评，严厉批评政策。Opposition leaders continued to excoriate the policy as harmful to workers. 反对派领导人继续严厉批评该政策对工人有害。 | ex->去除，cori->皮肤（拉丁corium），excoriate->剥皮=严厉批评（cf. corium真皮，coroner验尸官，leather皮革，excoriate痛斥） || 文化联想：鲁迅杂文常以尖锐笔锋猛烈批评社会弊病，很适合联想到 excoriate，可以说 **excoriate a social evil — “A sharp satirical essay may excoriate a social evil with language meant to sting and provoke reflection.”**

quiz.question: appropriate _____
quiz.explanation: 拨款，拨款。Congress voted to appropriate funds for disaster relief. 国会投票为救灾拨款。 | ap->朝向，propr->自己的（拉丁proprius），appropriate->使成为自己的=占用/拨款（cf. proper适当，property财产，propriety礼仪，expropriate征用） || 文化联想：灾害发生后政府拨出专项救灾资金，最适合帮助记忆 appropriate，可以说 **appropriate funds — “A government may appropriate funds for emergency housing, food, and reconstruction after a major disaster.”**

quiz.question: expropriate ____
quiz.explanation: 征用，征用土地。The government moved to expropriate land for the new highway project. 政府采取行动为新高速公路项目征用土地。 | ex->向外，propr->自己的，expropriate->使不再是自己的=征用（cf. appropriate占用，property财产，proper合适，propriety礼仪） || 文化联想：修高速公路或水库时依法征用土地的场景最适合联想到 expropriate，可以说 **expropriate land — “For a major infrastructure project, authorities may expropriate land under a legal compensation process.”**

quiz.question: repatriate ________
quiz.explanation: 遣返，遣返难民。International agencies worked to repatriate refugees to their home countries. 国际机构努力将难民遣返回本国。 | re->回，patri->父亲/祖国（拉丁pater），repatriate->送回祖国=遣返（cf. patriarch族长，paternal父亲的，patrician贵族，expatriate外籍人） || 文化联想：战乱结束后让流离海外的人返回祖国，最适合联想到 repatriate，可以说 **repatriate displaced people — “After a conflict ends, authorities may help repatriate displaced people who wish to return to their home country.”**

quiz.question: expatriate ______
quiz.explanation: 外籍的，外籍工人。The company hired an expatriate worker with extensive international experience. 公司雇用了一名具有丰富国际经验的外籍工人。 | ex->离开，patri->祖国，expatriate->离开祖国的人=外籍人（cf. repatriate遣返，patriot爱国者，paternal父亲的，compatible兼容） || 文化联想：上海、深圳等城市里的外籍员工最适合帮助记忆 expatriate，可以说 **an expatriate worker — “A multinational company in Shanghai may employ an expatriate worker who has moved to China for an overseas assignment.”**

quiz.question: striate ______
quiz.explanation: 有条纹的，横纹肌。The anatomy textbook showed detailed diagrams of striate muscle tissue. 解剖学教科书展示了横纹肌组织的详细图表。 | stri->条纹（拉丁stria->沟槽），striate->有条纹的（cf. striated striped有条纹，stripe条纹，striation条纹，stria沟槽） || 文化联想：人体解剖图里横纹肌一条条明暗相间，最适合联想到 striate，可以说 **striated muscle — “Under magnification, skeletal muscle appears as striated muscle with repeating light and dark bands.”**

quiz.question: infuriate ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 激怒，激怒人群。The speaker's insensitive remarks served only to infuriate the crowd. 演讲者不敏感的言论只会激怒人群。 | in->使，furi->愤怒（拉丁furia），infuriate->使愤怒=激怒（cf. fury愤怒，furious愤怒，furor公众愤怒，fusillade连续射击） || 文化联想：中文“火上浇油”最适合帮助记忆 infuriate，可以说 **infuriate the crowd — “An arrogant remark made during a tense protest can infuriate the crowd and make the situation far harder to control.”**

quiz.question: expatiate __
quiz.explanation: 详述，详述。The professor began to expatiate on the complexities of quantum mechanics. 教授开始详述量子力学的复杂性。 | ex->向外，pati->漫步（拉丁spatiari），expatiate->向外漫步=详细阐述（cf. spacious宽敞，space空间，spatial空间的，expatiate详述） || 文化联想：老师讲《红楼梦》人物关系时一讲就是半堂课，很适合联想到 expatiate，可以说 **expatiate on a topic — “A literature professor may expatiate on the Jia family’s decline for an entire lecture.”**

quiz.question: initiate _ _______
quiz.explanation: 启动，启动项目。The committee voted unanimously to initiate a project focused on renewable energy. 委员会一致投票启动一个专注于可再生能源的项目。 | init->开始（拉丁initium->起点），initiate->进入开始=启动（cf. initial最初，initiative主动，initiation入会，initial letter首字母） || 文化联想：大型工程开工仪式宣布项目正式启动，最适合帮助记忆 initiate，可以说 **initiate a project — “A city may initiate a new subway project after planning, funding, and approval are complete.”**

quiz.question: propitiate ____
quiz.explanation: 抚慰，抚慰神灵。Ancient civilizations performed rituals to propitiate gods and ensure good harvests. 古代文明举行仪式抚慰神灵以确保丰收。 | propiti->有利（拉丁propitius），propitiate->使有利于自己=平息（cf. propitious吉祥，propitiatory安抚的，favorable有利，auspicious吉祥） || 文化联想：传统祭祀中献香、供品以求神灵保佑风调雨顺，很适合联想到 propitiate，可以说 **propitiate the gods — “In an old harvest ritual, villagers might offer incense and food to propitiate the gods and pray for favorable weather.”**

quiz.question: vitiate ________
quiz.explanation: 损害，损害合同。The lawyer argued that fraud would vitiate contract and render it invalid. 律师辩称欺诈会损害合同使其无效。 | vitium->缺陷/罪（拉丁），vitiate->引入缺陷=损害（cf. vice恶习，vicious恶毒，vitiated受损的，virtuous有美德=无缺陷） || 文化联想：合同如果建立在欺诈之上，就可能失去效力，最适合联想到 vitiate，可以说 **vitiate a contract — “Fraud or coercion can vitiate a contract by undermining the validity of the agreement.”**

quiz.question: substantiate _____
quiz.explanation: 证实，证实声明。The researcher provided extensive evidence to substantiate claim. 研究人员提供了大量证据来证实该声明。 | sub->在下，stanti->站立（拉丁），substantiate->站得住脚=证实（cf. substance实质，substantial实质性的，substitute替代，constant恒定） || 文化联想：中文“有根有据”最适合帮助记忆 substantiate，可以说 **substantiate a claim — “A historian must use documents, inscriptions, or other evidence to substantiate a claim about the past.”**

quiz.question: differentiate ________
quiz.explanation: 区分，区分特征。It can be difficult to differentiate features between the two similar species. 很难区分两个相似物种之间的特征。 | differ->不同，entiate->使，differentiate->使不同=区分（cf. differ不同，different不同，indifferent漠然，differential差分） || 文化联想：品茶时辨别龙井、碧螺春等不同茶叶的香气和形态，很适合联想到 differentiate，可以说 **differentiate two varieties — “An experienced tea drinker can differentiate two varieties by their aroma, leaf shape, and flavor.”**

quiz.question: potentiate ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 增强，增强效果。Certain drugs can potentiate the effect of alcohol in the bloodstream. 某些药物可以增强血液中酒精的效果。 | potent->有力（拉丁potens），iate->使，potentiate->增强效力（cf. potential潜力，potent有力，impotent无力，omnipotent全能） || 文化联想：中药与西药同时使用时有时可能增强彼此作用，这可以帮助记忆 potentiate，可以说 **potentiate an effect — “Combining two medicines can sometimes potentiate an effect, which is why drug interactions must be checked carefully.”**

quiz.question: obviate ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 消除，消除需要。The new software will obviate the need for manual data entry. 新软件将消除手动输入数据的需要。 | ob->对抗，vi->道路（拉丁via），obviate->挡在路上=消除障碍（cf. obvious明显=在路上，devious弯路=偏离，previous之前，via经由） || 文化联想：有了高铁电子票后，不再需要纸质车票的场景很适合联想到 obviate，可以说 **obviate the need for something — “Electronic ticketing can obviate the need for a printed train ticket in many situations.”**

quiz.question: deviate ____ ____
quiz.explanation: 偏离，偏离道路。The pilot was forced to deviate from path due to severe weather. 由于恶劣天气飞行员被迫偏离航路。 | de->离开，vi->道路（拉丁via），deviate->离开道路=偏离（cf. devious迂回，obvious明显，previous之前，via经由，deviation偏差） || 文化联想：“离经叛道”里的“离开正道”很适合帮助记忆 deviate，可以说 **deviate from the path — “A person who abandons an agreed course and goes his own way may deviate from the path set by the group.”**

quiz.question: alleviate ____
quiz.explanation: 减轻，减轻疼痛。The doctor prescribed medication to alleviate pain after surgery. 医生开了药以减轻手术后的疼痛。 | al->使，levi->轻（拉丁levis），alleviate->使变轻=减轻（cf. levitate悬浮=变轻，lever杠杆，relief减轻，levity轻浮） || 文化联想：针灸、理疗或药物都可能用来减轻疼痛，很适合联想到 alleviate，可以说 **alleviate pain — “A patient may use medicine, physiotherapy, or other treatment to alleviate pain after an injury.”**

quiz.question: asphyxiate ______
quiz.explanation: 使窒息，使受害者窒息。Toxic fumes threatened to asphyxiate victim trapped inside. 有毒烟雾威胁要使困在里面的受害者窒息。 | a->无，sphyx->脉搏（希腊sphyzein->脉搏），asphyxiate->无脉=窒息（cf. asphyxia窒息，suffocate使窒息，choke窒息，stifle压制） || 文化联想：火灾现场浓烟会让被困人员窒息，最适合帮助记忆 asphyxiate，可以说 **asphyxiate a victim — “In a building fire, dense smoke can asphyxiate a trapped victim before the flames ever reach them.”**

quiz.question: relate _____
quiz.explanation: 讲述，讲述故事。The elderly woman began to relate story of her childhood during the war. 老妇人开始讲述她战争期间的童年故事。 | re->回，lat->携带（拉丁latus），relate->携带回来=讲述/联系（cf. relation关系，relative亲戚，relative相对，narrate叙述） || 文化联想：老人给晚辈讲抗战、知青或童年经历的场景最适合联想到 relate，可以说 **relate a story — “At a family gathering, an elderly relative may relate a story from childhood that younger generations have never heard.”**

quiz.question: inflate ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 夸大，夸大数字。The report attempted to inflate the numbers to make results appear more impressive. 报告试图夸大数字使结果看起来更令人印象深刻。 | in->进入，flat->吹（拉丁flare），inflate->吹进去=充气/夸大（cf. deflate泄气，flat平的，conflate混淆，flatulence胀气） || 文化联想：中文“注水数据”最适合帮助记忆 inflate，可以说 **inflate the numbers — “A dishonest report may inflate the numbers to make weak results look far more impressive than they really are.”**

quiz.question: conflate _____
quiz.explanation: 混淆，混淆观点。It is a common mistake to conflate ideas that are actually quite distinct. 将截然不同的观点混淆是常见错误。 | con->共同，flat->吹（拉丁），conflate->吹合在一起=混淆（cf. inflate夸大，deflate泄气，flatulent充满气的，conflation合并混淆） || 文化联想：把“儒家”和“所有中国传统思想”混为一谈，就是 conflate 的典型错误，可以说 **conflate two ideas — “It is a mistake to conflate Confucian thought with every other tradition in Chinese philosophy.”**

quiz.question: invigilate __ ____
quiz.explanation: 监考，监考考试。The teacher was assigned to invigilate an exam for the final-year students. 老师被指派监考期末学生的考试。 | in->使，vigil->清醒（拉丁vigil），invigilate->保持清醒看守=监考（cf. vigil守夜，vigilant警惕，vigilance警惕，invigorate振奋） || 文化联想：科举考试里的监临、巡察人员要防止作弊，很适合联想到 invigilate，可以说 **invigilate an examination — “Officials in the imperial examination system had to invigilate the examination and watch closely for cheating.”**

quiz.question: assimilate __________
quiz.explanation: 同化，同化移民。The program was designed to help assimilate immigrants into mainstream society. 该项目旨在帮助移民同化进入主流社会。 | as->朝向，simil->相似（拉丁similis），assimilate->使相似=同化（cf. similar相似，simulate模拟，dissimilar不同，simile明喻） || 文化联想：海外移民进入新的社会后逐渐学习当地语言、习俗和制度，很适合联想到 assimilate，可以说 **assimilate into society — “A newcomer may gradually assimilate into society by learning the language, customs, and everyday norms of the new country.”**

quiz.question: ventilate ____
quiz.explanation: 通风，给房间通风。Open the windows to ventilate room and remove stale air. 打开窗户给房间通风并排出污浊空气。 | vent->风（拉丁ventus），ilate->使，ventilate->使有风=通风（cf. wind风，vent出口，ventilation通风，event事件=风来了） || 文化联想：夏天开窗形成穿堂风给房间换气，最适合帮助记忆 ventilate，可以说 **ventilate a room — “Opening windows on opposite sides of a traditional courtyard house can help ventilate a room and remove stale air.”**

quiz.question: flagellate ____
quiz.explanation: 有鞭毛的，鞭毛细胞。The biology student examined flagellate cell under high magnification. 生物学学生在高倍放大镜下检查鞭毛细胞。 | flagell->鞭子（拉丁flagellum），flagellate->有鞭子的=有鞭毛的（cf. flagellum鞭毛，flagellate鞭打，self-flagellation自我惩罚） || 文化联想：中学生物课观察眼虫时能看到一根帮助运动的鞭毛，最适合联想到 flagellate，可以说 **a flagellate cell — “Under a microscope, a euglena is a flagellate cell that moves with the help of a whip-like flagellum.”**

quiz.question: vacillate _______
quiz.explanation: 犹豫，在两者间犹豫。She continued to vacillate between accepting the job offer and staying at her current position. 她继续在接受工作机会和留在现职位之间犹豫。 | vacill->摇摆（拉丁vacillare），vacillate->摇摆=犹豫不决（cf. waver动摇，hesitate犹豫，oscillate振荡，ambivalent矛盾心理） || 文化联想：中文“举棋不定”最适合帮助记忆 vacillate，可以说 **vacillate between two choices — “Someone who is ‘举棋不定’ may vacillate between two choices and keep delaying a decision.”**

quiz.question: oscillate ______
quiz.explanation: 振荡，剧烈振荡。Stock prices began to oscillate wildly in response to market uncertainty. 股票价格开始剧烈振荡以应对市场的不确定性。 | oscill->秋千（拉丁oscillum），oscillate->像秋千一样摆动=振荡（cf. oscillator振荡器，vacillate犹豫，fluctuate波动，undulate波动） || 文化联想：寺庙大钟被敲响后钟摆来回摆动、声音逐渐衰减，很适合联想到 oscillate，可以说 **oscillate back and forth — “After a large temple bell is struck, its suspended parts may oscillate back and forth before gradually coming to rest.”**

quiz.question: percolate ______
quiz.explanation: 渗透，煮咖啡。The aroma filled the kitchen as the machine began to percolate coffee. 机器开始煮咖啡时香气充满了厨房。 | per->穿透，col->过滤（拉丁colare），percolate->穿透过滤=渗透/煮（cf. filter过滤，percolation渗透，seep渗，trickle细流） || 文化联想：手冲咖啡时热水慢慢渗过滤纸和咖啡粉，最适合帮助记忆 percolate，可以说 **water percolates through coffee grounds — “During pour-over coffee, hot water percolates through the coffee grounds and filter before dripping into the cup.”**

quiz.question: immolate _______
quiz.explanation: 焚烧，自焚。The protester threatened to immolate oneself in front of the government building. 抗议者威胁要在政府大楼前自焚。 | im->在上，mol->磨（拉丁mola->磨石/祭品），immolate->在祭石上奉献=牺牲/焚烧（cf. mole摩尔，molecule分子，immolation献祭） || 文化联想：佛教典籍中“舍身”故事可以帮助理解 immolate 的“献祭/焚毁”义，但不能把它当作普通佛教行为，可以说 **immolate oneself — “In an extreme act of self-sacrifice described in some historical accounts, a person may immolate himself, though such acts are exceptional rather than ordinary practice.”**

quiz.question: extrapolate _____
quiz.explanation: 推断，推断趋势。Economists attempted to extrapolate trend from the limited data available. 经济学家试图从有限数据中推断趋势。 | extra->超出，pol->柱（拉丁polire->磨光），extrapolate->超出已知点推延=推断（cf. interpolate插值，extrapolation外推，interpolation内插） || 文化联想：根据过去几年房价走势继续推算未来趋势，很适合联想到 extrapolate，可以说 **extrapolate a trend — “An analyst may extrapolate a housing-price trend from several years of data, though the projection can still be wrong.”**

quiz.question: interpolate ____
quiz.explanation: 插入，插值数据。The software can interpolate data to fill in missing values. 该软件可以插值数据以填补缺失值。 | inter->之间，pol->磨光，interpolate->在两点之间插入=内插（cf. extrapolate外推，interpose插入，interpolation内插法） || 文化联想：中国中学数学里根据已知点估算中间值就是插值，很适合联想到 interpolate，可以说 **interpolate a value — “Given two measured points, a student may interpolate a value that lies between them.”**

quiz.question: desolate _________
quiz.explanation: 荒凉的，荒凉的景观。The travelers crossed a desolate landscape with no signs of human habitation. 旅行者穿越了荒凉的景观没有人类居住的迹象。 | de->彻底，sol->单独（拉丁solus），desolate->彻底单独=荒凉的（cf. solitude孤独，sole唯一，solo独奏，console安慰=不再孤独） || 文化联想：西北戈壁荒无人烟、一眼望不到村庄的景象最适合联想到 desolate，可以说 **a desolate landscape — “Across parts of the Gobi, a traveler may see a desolate landscape with bare ground, distant hills, and almost no habitation.”**

quiz.question: insolate _______
quiz.explanation: 日晒，晒样品。Researchers needed to insolate samples for several hours to complete the experiment. 研究人员需要晒样品几个小时以完成实验。 | in->使，sol->太阳（拉丁sol），insolate->使暴露在太阳下=日晒（cf. solar太阳的，solstice至点，parasol遮阳伞，insolation日照） || 文化联想：农作物研究中把样品放在阳光下做日照处理，最适合联想到 insolate，可以说 **insolate a sample — “In an agricultural experiment, researchers may insolate a plant sample for a fixed number of hours to study the effect of sunlight.”**

quiz.question: slate _ _________
quiz.explanation: 提名，提名候选人。The party committee decided to slate a candidate for the upcoming election. 党委会决定为即将到来的选举提名候选人。 | slate->石板（古法语esclate），slate->用石板列名=提名（cf. slate清单/石板，clean slate重新开始，slate grey青灰色） || 文化联想：现代选举或组织内部先确定一名候选人参选，可以帮助记忆 slate，可以说 **slate a candidate — “A political organization may slate a candidate after internal discussion and selection.”**

quiz.question: legislate ______
quiz.explanation: 立法，立法改革。Parliament moved quickly to legislate reform in the healthcare system. 议会迅速对医疗保健系统进行立法改革。 | leg->法律（拉丁lex），islate->使，legislate->制定法律=立法（cf. legislature立法机关，legal合法，legislation法规，illegitimate非法） || 文化联想：国家通过立法形式建立新的环保或劳动规则，最适合联想到 legislate，可以说 **legislate reform — “A legislature may legislate reform by passing new rules on labor, environmental protection, or public safety.”**

quiz.question: perambulate _______
quiz.explanation: 巡视，巡视街道。The security guard would perambulate streets throughout the night. 保安会在整个夜晚巡视街道。 | per->穿过，ambul->走（拉丁ambulare），perambulate->穿过走动=巡视（cf. ambulance救护车=走动的，ambulatory门诊的，amble漫步） || 文化联想：古代更夫夜里沿街巡查、报时的场景很适合联想到 perambulate，可以说 **perambulate the streets — “A night watchman in an old Chinese town might perambulate the streets while sounding a clapper to mark the hours.”**

quiz.question: discombobulate _____
quiz.explanation: 使混乱，使计划混乱。The unexpected announcement served to discombobulate plans for the merger. 出乎意料的公告使合并计划变得混乱。 | discombobulate->幽默词（可能来自 discompose+disconcert），使完全混乱（cf. disconcert使困惑，discombobulate搞乱，bamboozle欺骗） || 文化联想：中文“打乱阵脚”最适合帮助记忆 discombobulate，可以说 **discombobulate the plan — “A sudden change in orders can discombobulate the entire plan and leave everyone unsure what to do next.”**

quiz.question: maculate ______
quiz.explanation: 玷污，玷污记录。The scandal threatened to maculate record of an otherwise distinguished career. 丑闻威胁要玷污杰出职业生涯的记录。 | macul->斑点（拉丁macula），maculate->使有斑点=玷污（cf. immaculate无瑕=无斑点，immaculate conception无染原罪，macular黄斑的） || 文化联想：中文“留下污点”最适合帮助记忆 maculate，可以说 **maculate a reputation — “A major scandal can maculate an otherwise distinguished reputation by leaving a stain that is hard to erase.”**

quiz.question: peculate _____
quiz.explanation: 挪用，挪用资金。The treasurer was accused of attempting to peculate funds from the organization. 财务主管被指控试图挪用该组织的资金。 | pecul->私人财产（拉丁pecunia->金钱），peculate->侵占他人财产=挪用（cf. peculiar特别=属于个人的，pecuniary金钱的，peculium私有财产） || 文化联想：贪官偷偷挪用公款最适合帮助记忆 peculate，可以说 **peculate public funds — “A corrupt treasurer who secretly diverts government money for personal use may peculate public funds.”**

quiz.question: speculate __ ______
quiz.explanation: 投机，炒股。Many investors lost money when they chose to speculate on stocks during the market bubble. 许多投资者在市场泡沫期间炒股而亏损。 | spec->观察（拉丁specere），speculate->观察可能性=推测/投机（cf. spectacle景象，inspect检查，respect尊重，spectacular壮观） || 文化联想：中文“炒股投机”是 speculate 最熟悉的现代场景之一，可以说 **speculate on stocks — “During a market bubble, some investors may speculate on stocks simply because they expect prices to keep rising.”**

quiz.question: matriculate __
quiz.explanation: 入学，入学于。She was excited to matriculate at her first-choice university. 她很兴奋能入学于首选大学。 | matric->母亲（拉丁mater），matriculate->进入母亲的怀抱=入学（cf. matrix矩阵=子宫，maternal母亲的，matricide弑母，matron老妇人） || 文化联想：中国大学新生正式注册入学的场景最适合联想到 matriculate，可以说 **matriculate at a university — “After receiving an admission offer and completing registration, a student can matriculate at the university in the fall.”**

quiz.question: articulate _______
quiz.explanation: 善于表达的，善于表达的演讲者。The articulate speaker captivated the audience with her clear arguments. 这位善于表达的演讲者以清晰论点吸引了观众。 | artic->关节（拉丁articulus），articulate->用关节连接=清晰表达（cf. article文章/冠词，joint关节，articulation发音/关节） || 文化联想：中文“能言善辩、条理清楚”最适合帮助记忆 articulate，可以说 **an articulate speaker — “A debater who presents complex ideas in clear, orderly language is an articulate speaker.”**

quiz.question: inoculate ________
quiz.explanation: 接种，给儿童接种。The health department launched a campaign to inoculate children against measles. 卫生部门发起了给儿童接种麻疹疫苗的运动。 | in->进入，ocul->眼/芽（拉丁oculus），inoculate->将芽植入=接种（cf. ocular眼部的，oculist眼科医生，eye眼，oculus圆眼窗） || 文化联想：儿童接种麻疹、乙肝等疫苗的场景最适合帮助记忆 inoculate，可以说 **inoculate children — “A public-health campaign may inoculate children against preventable infectious diseases.”**

quiz.question: circulate _ ____
quiz.explanation: 传阅，传阅备忘录。The manager asked her assistant to circulate a memo about the new policy. 经理要求助理传阅关于新政策的备忘录。 | circ->圆（拉丁circus），circulate->绕圈传递=传阅（cf. circle圆，circuit回路，circumference周长，circus马戏团=圆形场地） || 文化联想：机关内部把文件依次传给各部门阅读，就是 circulate 的典型场景，可以说 **circulate a document — “An office may circulate a policy memo so that every department can read and comment on it.”**

quiz.question: emasculate ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 削弱，削弱法案。Amendments threatened to emasculate the bill and remove its most important provisions. 修正案威胁要削弱法案并删除最重要的条款。 | e->去除，mascul->男性（拉丁masculus），emasculate->去除男性力量=削弱（cf. masculine男性，mascot吉祥物，male男性，castrate阉割） || 文化联想：一项法律如果不断被删掉关键条款，最后可能被“掏空”，最适合联想到 emasculate，可以说 **emasculate a bill — “Removing all of a bill’s enforcement provisions can emasculate the bill until it has little practical effect.”**

quiz.question: adulate _ _________
quiz.explanation: 阿谀奉承，阿谀奉承名人。Fans gathered to adulate a celebrity they had admired for years. 粉丝聚集阿谀奉承他们崇拜多年的名人。 | adul->讨好（拉丁adulari->像狗一样摇尾），adulate->过分奉承（cf. adulation奉承，flattery谄媚，sycophant马屁精，adulatory奉承的） || 文化联想：中文“阿谀奉承”最适合帮助记忆 adulate，可以说 **adulate a powerful person — “A courtier who constantly flatters a powerful official may adulate him in hopes of winning favor.”**

quiz.question: modulate ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 调节，调节音调。Professional singers learn to modulate the tone of their voice for different effects. 专业歌手学习调节音调产生不同效果。 | modul->尺度（拉丁modus），modulate->按尺度调整=调节（cf. module模块，model模型，mode模式，modify修改，mood情绪） || 文化联想：京剧唱腔会通过高低强弱变化来调节声音效果，最适合联想到 modulate，可以说 **modulate the voice — “A Peking-opera singer must modulate the voice carefully to shape pitch, intensity, and emotional color.”**

quiz.question: coagulate _____
quiz.explanation: 凝结，凝结血液。Certain proteins help coagulate blood and stop bleeding from wounds. 某些蛋白质帮助凝结血液并止住伤口出血。 | co->共同，agul->凝固（拉丁coagulare），coagulate->共同凝固=凝结（cf. coagulation凝固，congeal凝固，clot血凝块，curdle凝固） || 文化联想：中医外伤或现代急救都要依靠血液凝固来止血，最适合联想到 coagulate，可以说 **blood coagulates — “After a small cut, the blood gradually coagulates and forms a clot that helps stop the bleeding.”**

quiz.question: regulate ___________
quiz.explanation: 调节，调节温度。The thermostat works automatically to regulate temperature throughout the building. 恒温器自动工作以调节整个建筑物的温度。 | reg->统治（拉丁regere），regulate->按规则统治=调节（cf. regular规则，reign统治，regal皇家，regiment管制，deregulate解除管制） || 文化联想：空调恒温器自动调节室内温度是最直观的 regulate 场景，可以说 **regulate temperature — “A thermostat can regulate indoor temperature by switching heating or cooling on and off as needed.”**

quiz.question: pullulate ____ ____
quiz.explanation: 充满，充满生机。The coral reef seemed to pullulate with life in every crevice. 珊瑚礁的每个缝隙都似乎充满生机。 | pullul->发芽（拉丁pullulare->发芽），pullulate->大量繁殖=充满（cf. proliferate增生，teem充满，swarm群集，abound充满） || 文化联想：南海珊瑚礁鱼群、甲壳类和其他生物密集繁衍的景象很适合联想到 pullulate，可以说 **pullulate with life — “A healthy coral reef can pullulate with life, with fish and small creatures filling nearly every crevice.”**

quiz.question: emulate _ _____
quiz.explanation: 效仿，效仿榜样。Young athletes often try to emulate a model they consider successful. 年轻运动员经常试图效仿他们认为成功的榜样。 | aemul->竞争（拉丁aemulus->竞争者），emulate->与...竞争=效仿（cf. emulation效仿，rival竞争对手，simulate模拟，mimic模仿） || 文化联想：年轻书法家临摹王羲之、颜真卿的作品就是典型 emulate，可以说 **emulate a master — “A young calligrapher may emulate Wang Xizhi by studying and copying the rhythm and structure of his brushwork.”**

quiz.question: dissimulate ________
quiz.explanation: 掩饰，掩饰感情。She learned to dissimulate feelings to maintain her professional demeanor. 她学会了掩饰感情以保持职业风度。 | dis->否定，simul->相似（拉丁），dissimulate->使看起来不同=掩饰（cf. simulate模拟，dissemble掩饰，feign假装，pretend假装） || 文化联想：中文“喜怒不形于色”最适合帮助记忆 dissimulate，可以说 **dissimulate one’s feelings — “Someone trained to keep ‘joy and anger from showing on the face’ may dissimulate his feelings even under pressure.”**

quiz.question: accumulate ______
quiz.explanation: 积累，积累财富。Through careful investing and saving, they managed to accumulate wealth over the years. 通过谨慎投资和储蓄他们多年来成功积累了财富。 | ac->朝向，cumul->堆（拉丁cumulus），accumulate->向堆叠=积累（cf. cumulus积云，cumulate堆积，accumulation积累，reservoir储备） || 文化联想：中文“积少成多”最适合帮助记忆 accumulate，可以说 **accumulate wealth gradually — “The saying ‘small amounts accumulate into much’ describes how a family may accumulate wealth gradually through saving over many years.”**

quiz.question: stipulate _____
quiz.explanation: 规定，规定条款。The contract clearly stipulate terms for payment and delivery. 合同明确规定了付款和交付的条款。 | stipul->茎/条件（拉丁stipulari->议定），stipulate->正式议定=规定（cf. stipulation规定，condition条件，proviso附带条件，clause条款） || 文化联想：合同里白纸黑字明确规定付款日期、违约责任等条款，最适合联想到 stipulate，可以说 **stipulate the terms — “A formal contract should stipulate the payment schedule, delivery date, and consequences of breach.”**

quiz.question: insulate _____
quiz.explanation: 绝缘，使电线绝缘。Electricians must properly insulate wires to prevent electrical hazards. 电工必须正确使电线绝缘以防止电气危险。 | insul->岛（拉丁insula），insulate->使像岛一样隔离=绝缘（cf. island岛，insular岛国的/孤立的，isolate隔离，peninsula半岛） || 文化联想：家庭装修时电线外面包绝缘层防止漏电，最适合帮助记忆 insulate，可以说 **insulate electrical wires — “An electrician must properly insulate electrical wires so that exposed current does not create a shock or fire hazard.”**

quiz.question: encapsulate ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 概括，概括想法。The phrase seemed to perfectly encapsulate the idea he had been trying to express. 这个短语似乎完美地概括了他试图表达的想法。 | en->使，capsul->小容器（拉丁capsula），encapsulate->放入小容器=概括（cf. capsule胶囊，capture捕获，chapter章节，captain队长） || 文化联想：中文“一言以蔽之”最适合帮助记忆 encapsulate，可以说 **encapsulate an idea — “A short proverb can encapsulate an idea that would otherwise require a long explanation.”**

quiz.question: capitulate __ _____
quiz.explanation: 投降，向武力投降。The besieged city was forced to capitulate to force after months of resistance. 被围困的城市在抵抗数月后被迫向武力投降。 | capit->头（拉丁caput），capitulate->低头=投降（cf. capital首都=头，captain队长=头，decapitate斩首，recapitulate再概括） || 文化联想：南宋末年城池被围、粮尽援绝后被迫投降的场景很适合联想到 capitulate，可以说 **capitulate after a siege — “A city cut off from food and reinforcements may eventually capitulate after a long siege.”**

quiz.question: recapitulate ______
quiz.explanation: 概括，概括要点。At the end of the lecture, the professor took time to recapitulate points for clarity. 讲座结束时教授花时间概括要点以求清晰。 | re->再次，capit->头，recapitulate->再次从头整理=概括（cf. capitulate投降，capital首都，captain队长，chapter章节=小头） || 文化联想：老师讲完一堂课后再把几个重点重新概括一遍，最适合联想到 recapitulate，可以说 **recapitulate the main points — “At the end of the lesson, the teacher may recapitulate the main points so students remember the structure of the argument.”**

quiz.question: postulate ______
quiz.explanation: 假定，假定理论。Scientists must postulate theory before conducting experiments to test it. 科学家必须在进行实验测试之前假定理论。 | postul->要求（拉丁postulare），postulate->要求接受=假定（cf. postulation假定，posit假设，axiom公理，hypothesis假设） || 文化联想：中国传统天文学提出某种宇宙模型前也需要先作假设，可以帮助记忆 postulate，可以说 **postulate a theory — “An astronomer may postulate a theory about celestial motion and then compare it with repeated observations.”**

quiz.question: expostulate ____
quiz.explanation: 劝诫，劝诫。The teacher tried to expostulate with the student about his poor attendance. 老师试图就学生的出勤率不佳对他进行劝诫。 | ex->向外，postul->要求，expostulate->向外提出要求=劝诫（cf. postulate假定，remonstrate劝告，admonish告诫，exhort劝告） || 文化联想：老师面对屡次迟到的学生耐心劝诫，最适合联想到 expostulate，可以说 **expostulate with a student — “A teacher may expostulate with a student about repeated lateness and explain why the behavior must change.”**

quiz.question: amalgamate _____
quiz.explanation: 合并，合并公司。The two competing companies decided to amalgamate firms to increase market share. 两家竞争公司决定合并以增加市场份额。 | amalgam->汞合金（希腊，可能来自Arabic amalgam->联合），amalgamate->合并（cf. amalgam合金，merge合并，consolidate巩固，fuse融合） || 文化联想：近代商号或现代企业合并成更大机构最适合帮助记忆 amalgamate，可以说 **amalgamate two firms — “Two competing companies may amalgamate into a single larger firm in order to combine capital, staff, and markets.”**

quiz.question: __________ stalemate
quiz.explanation: 僵局，外交僵局。Negotiations reached a diplomatic stalemate with neither side willing to compromise. 谈判陷入外交僵局双方都不愿妥协。 | stale->僵停的位置（国际象棋术语），mate->将军，stalemate->不能移动的将军=僵局（cf. check将军，checkmate将死，impasse僵局） || 文化联想：楚汉相争在鸿沟对峙、双方一时谁也无法彻底击败对方，可以帮助记忆 stalemate，可以说 **a military stalemate — “When two armies face each other for months without a decisive breakthrough, the conflict can settle into a military stalemate.”**

quiz.question: decimate ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 大量毁灭，大量消灭队伍。The plague threatened to decimate the ranks of the army. 瘟疫威胁要大量消灭军队的队伍。 | decim->十分之一（拉丁decem->十），decimate->杀十分之一（古罗马军法中对叛乱部队每十人杀一人，cf. decimal小数，decade十年，December十二月） || 文化联想：一场严重瘟疫如果让一支军队大批减员，最适合联想到 decimate，可以说 **decimate the ranks — “A devastating epidemic can decimate the ranks of an army by killing or disabling a large share of its soldiers.”**

quiz.question: sublimate ______
quiz.explanation: 升华，升华欲望。The artist learned to sublimate desire into creative expression. 这位艺术家学会了将欲望升华为创造性表达。 | sub->在下，lim->门槛（拉丁limen），sublimate->越过门槛=升华（cf. sublime崇高=越过门槛，subliminal潜意识=在门槛以下，limit限制） || 文化联想：传统文人把失意、愤懑转化成诗画创作，最适合帮助记忆 sublimate，可以说 **sublimate emotion into art — “A frustrated scholar may sublimate grief or anger into poetry, calligraphy, or painting.”**

quiz.question: acclimate _______
quiz.explanation: 适应，快速适应。New employees were expected to acclimate quickly to the fast-paced work environment. 新员工被期望快速适应快节奏的工作环境。 | ac->朝向，climat->气候（希腊klima->倾斜），acclimate->适应气候=适应（cf. climate气候，acclimatize适应，adapt适应，climatology气候学） || 文化联想：北方人初到海南需要一段时间适应炎热潮湿的气候，最适合联想到 acclimate，可以说 **acclimate to the climate — “Someone arriving from northern China may need time to acclimate to Hainan’s heat and humidity.”**

quiz.question: inanimate ______
quiz.explanation: 无生命的，无生命的物体。The child's imagination brought the inanimate object to life in her story. 孩子的想象力在故事中赋予了无生命的物体生命。 | in->否定，anim->生命（拉丁anima），inanimate->无生命的（cf. animate有生命的，animal动物，animosity敌意，animated活跃的，anime动画） || 文化联想：中国画里的山石、器物虽然本身没有生命，却能通过笔墨显得有神韵，很适合联想到 inanimate，可以说 **an inanimate object — “In a skilled ink painting, even an inanimate object such as a rock or old vessel can seem full of character.”**

quiz.question: primate _______
quiz.explanation: 灵长类动物，灵长类动物物种。Scientists have identified over 500 primate species in tropical forests. 科学家已确认热带森林中500多种灵长类动物物种。 | primus->第一（拉丁），primate->第一等的动物=灵长类（cf. prime首要，primary主要，premier首相，primacy首位，primate大主教） || 文化联想：川金丝猴是中国最有代表性的灵长类动物之一，最适合帮助记忆 primate，可以说 **a primate species — “The golden snub-nosed monkey is a primate species native to the mountain forests of central China.”**

quiz.question: legitimate _____
quiz.explanation: 合法的，合法的要求。The plaintiff presented evidence to support his legitimate claim. 原告提出证据支持他的合法要求。 | leg->法律（拉丁lex），legitimate->符合法律的=合法的（cf. legal合法，legislature立法机关，illegitimate非法，legislation法规） || 文化联想：中文“合情合理、依法有据”最适合帮助记忆 legitimate，可以说 **a legitimate claim — “A request supported by both evidence and law can be treated as a legitimate claim.”**

quiz.question: illegitimate _____
quiz.explanation: 私生的，私生子。In medieval times, an illegitimate child had no rights to inheritance. 在中世纪，私生子没有继承权。 | il->否定，legitimate->合法的，illegitimate->不合法的（cf. legitimate合法，illegal非法，legitimize合法化，bastard私生子） || 文化联想：传统宗族社会会严格区分婚生与非婚生子女的身份，这种历史背景可帮助理解 illegitimate，可以说 **an illegitimate child — “In older legal and family systems, an illegitimate child could face restrictions that did not apply to a child born within a recognized marriage.”**

quiz.question: penultimate _______
quiz.explanation: 倒数第二的，倒数第二章。The penultimate chapter revealed the murderer's identity. 倒数第二章揭示了凶手的身份。 | pen->几乎（拉丁paene），ultimate->最后，penultimate->几乎是最后的=倒数第二（cf. peninsula半岛=几乎是岛，penumbra半影，penury贫困） || 文化联想：章回小说读到最后两回时，倒数第二回就是 penultimate chapter，可以说 **the penultimate chapter — “In a hundred-chapter novel, Chapter 99 is the penultimate chapter, immediately before the ending.”**

quiz.question: intimate ______
quiz.explanation: 亲密的，亲密的朋友。She confided her deepest secrets only to her most intimate friend. 她只向最亲密的朋友吐露最深的秘密。 | intimus->最内部的（拉丁），intimate->最内部的=亲密的（cf. interior内部，internal内部，intimacy亲密，intimidate恐吓=进入内部） || 文化联想：中文“知己”最适合帮助记忆 intimate friend，可以说 **an intimate friend — “A true 知己 is an intimate friend with whom one can share thoughts that are kept from almost everyone else.”**

quiz.question: proximate _____
quiz.explanation: 最接近的，近因。The investigation identified driver negligence as the proximate cause of the accident. 调查确定驾驶员疏忽是事故的近因。 | proxim->近（拉丁proximus），proximate->最近的（cf. proximity接近，approximate大约，approximately大约，next下一个） || 文化联想：查事故时常要区分背景因素和直接导致事故发生的近因，最适合联想到 proximate，可以说 **the proximate cause — “If a driver runs a red light and immediately causes a collision, that violation may be identified as the proximate cause of the crash.”**

quiz.question: approximate _____
quiz.explanation: 大约的，近似值。The surveyor could only provide an approximate value for the land. 测量员只能提供该土地的近似值。 | ap->朝向，proxim->近，approximate->朝近处=大约的（cf. proximate最近的，proximity接近，approximation近似值，rough粗略） || 文化联想：中文“八九不离十”最适合帮助记忆 approximate，可以说 **an approximate value — “An estimate described as ‘八九不离十’ gives an approximate value that is close to the true figure without being exact.”**

quiz.question: consummate ____________
quiz.explanation: 完美的，完美的专业人士。Her dedication made her a consummate professional. 她的奉献精神使她成为完美的专业人士。 | con->完全，summ->最高（拉丁summus），consummate->达到最高点=完美的（cf. summit顶峰，sum总和，consummation完成，assume假设） || 文化联想：中文“炉火纯青”形容技艺已经达到极高境界，最适合联想到 consummate，可以说 **a consummate professional — “A master craftsman whose skill has reached ‘炉火纯青’ can be regarded as a consummate professional.”**

quiz.question: alienate __________
quiz.explanation: 疏远，疏远支持者。The politician's remarks threatened to alienate supporters. 政客的言论威胁要疏远支持者。 | alien->外来的（拉丁alienus->他人的），alienate->使变成外来人=疏远（cf. alien外星人，alienation疏离，inalienable不可剥夺） || 文化联想：中文“众叛亲离”最适合帮助记忆 alienate，可以说 **alienate one’s supporters — “An arrogant leader who repeatedly ignores loyal followers may gradually alienate his supporters until even old allies leave.”**

quiz.question: concatenate _______
quiz.explanation: 连接，连接字符串。The program needs to concatenate strings from multiple sources. 该程序需要将来自多个来源的字符串连接成一个输出。 | con->共同，caten->链（拉丁catena），concatenate->链接在一起（cf. chain链，catenary悬链线，concatenation连接，enchained被锁链） || 文化联想：中文姓名数据库里常要把姓和名两个字符串连接起来，最适合联想到 concatenate，可以说 **concatenate two strings — “A program can concatenate the surname ‘王’ and the given name ‘小明’ to produce the full name ‘王小明.’”**

quiz.question: rejuvenate ____
quiz.explanation: 使恢复活力，使皮肤恢复活力。The new moisturizer claims to rejuvenate skin. 这款新保湿霜声称能使皮肤恢复活力。 | re->再次，juven->年轻（拉丁juvenis），rejuvenate->使再次年轻=恢复活力（cf. juvenile青少年，junior年轻，youth青春，rejuvenation复兴） || 文化联想：中文“返老还童”最适合帮助记忆 rejuvenate，可以说 **rejuvenate the skin — “A skincare advertisement may promise to rejuvenate the skin and make it look fresher and more youthful.”**

quiz.question: ________ magnate
quiz.explanation: 巨头，商业巨头。The business magnate donated millions to charitable causes. 商业巨头向慈善事业捐赠了数百万美元。 | magn->大（拉丁magnus），magnate->权贵大人物（cf. magnificent宏伟，magnify放大，magnitude量级，magnanimous宽宏大量） || 文化联想：晋商、徽商中拥有巨大财富和商业网络的大商人很适合联想到 magnate，可以说 **a business magnate — “A wealthy salt merchant with influence across several provinces could become a business magnate of his era.”**

quiz.question: designate _ _________
quiz.explanation: 指定，指定继任者。The retiring CEO needed to designate a successor. 即将退休的首席执行官需要指定继任者。 | de->彻底，sign->标记（拉丁signum），designate->标记指定（cf. design设计，signal信号，signature签名，assign分配，resign辞职） || 文化联想：古代皇帝正式立太子，就是最典型的指定继承人场景，可以说 **designate a successor — “An emperor could designate a successor by formally naming one of his sons crown prince.”**

quiz.question: cognate ________
quiz.explanation: 同源的，同源语言。Spanish and Italian are cognate language sharing many common roots. 西班牙语和意大利语是同源语言有许多共同词根。 | co->共同，gnat->出生（拉丁natus），cognate->共同出生=同源的（cf. nature自然，native本地，nascent新生，innate天生，pregnant怀孕） || 文化联想：汉语各方言中很多词虽然读音已经不同，却能追溯到共同来源，很适合联想到 cognate，可以说 **cognate forms — “Mandarin and Cantonese contain many cognate forms that descend from earlier stages of Chinese despite major differences in pronunciation.”**

quiz.question: deracinate _________
quiz.explanation: 根除，根除传统。Rapid modernization threatened to deracinate tradition that had lasted centuries. 快速现代化威胁要根除持续了几个世纪的传统。 | de->去除，racin->根（法语racine），deracinate->连根拔起=根除（cf. radical根本，radish萝卜，eradicate根除，uproot根除） || 文化联想：中文“连根拔起”几乎就是 deracinate 的字面画面，可以说 **deracinate a tradition — “Rapid social change can deracinate a local tradition if the community that once sustained it disappears.”**

quiz.question: vaccinate ________
quiz.explanation: 接种疫苗，给儿童接种疫苗。Health officials urged parents to vaccinate children. 卫生官员敦促父母给儿童接种疫苗。 | vacca->母牛（拉丁），vaccinate->用牛痘接种（詹纳用牛痘预防天花，cf. vaccine疫苗，bovine牛的，cow牛，vaccination接种） || 文化联想：中国儿童按免疫程序接种疫苗是最直观的 vaccinate 场景，可以说 **vaccinate children — “Community clinics routinely vaccinate children against preventable infectious diseases according to the immunization schedule.”**

quiz.question: fascinate ___ ________
quiz.explanation: 使着迷，使观众着迷。The magician's tricks continued to fascinate the audience. 魔术师的戏法继续使观众着迷。 | fascinum->魔咒（拉丁），fascinate->施加魔咒=使着迷（cf. fascism法西斯=束棒象征，fascination迷恋，captivate迷住） || 文化联想：川剧变脸瞬间切换脸谱的表演很容易让观众着迷，最适合联想到 fascinate，可以说 **fascinate the audience — “The rapid face-changing technique of Sichuan opera can fascinate the audience because each transformation seems almost instantaneous.”**

quiz.question: insubordinate ________
quiz.explanation: 不服从的，不服从的员工。The manager had no choice but to discipline the insubordinate employee. 经理别无选择只能惩戒不服从的员工。 | in->否定，sub->在下，ordin->命令（拉丁），insubordinate->不在命令之下=不服从的（cf. subordinate下属，ordinate坐标，ordain任命） || 文化联想：军营里公然抗命、不服从指挥的士兵最适合联想到 insubordinate，可以说 **an insubordinate soldier — “A soldier who openly refuses a lawful order may be disciplined as an insubordinate member of the unit.”**

quiz.question: inordinate _____
quiz.explanation: 过度的，过度的延误。The project suffered from inordinate delay due to bureaucratic obstacles. 项目因官僚障碍遭受了过度延误。 | in->否定，ordin->有序（拉丁ordinatus），inordinate->失去秩序的=过度的（cf. order秩序，ordinary普通，orderly有序，coordinate协调） || 文化联想：中文“拖得没完没了”很适合帮助记忆 inordinate，可以说 **an inordinate delay — “A permit that should take days but remains stuck for months has suffered an inordinate delay.”**

quiz.question: pollinate _______
quiz.explanation: 授粉，给花授粉。Bees play a crucial role in helping to pollinate flowers. 蜜蜂在帮助花授粉方面发挥至关重要的作用。 | pollen->花粉（拉丁），pollinate->传播花粉=授粉（cf. pollen花粉，pollinators授粉者，cross-pollination异花授粉） || 文化联想：果园里蜜蜂在花间飞舞、帮助苹果或梨树授粉，最适合联想到 pollinate，可以说 **pollinate the flowers — “Bees moving through an orchard help pollinate the flowers so that the trees can later produce fruit.”**

quiz.question: laminate ________
quiz.explanation: 层压的，层压地板。The homeowners chose durable laminate flooring for the kitchen renovation. 房主为厨房翻新选择了耐用的层压地板。 | lamina->薄板（拉丁），laminate->用薄板层叠=层压的（cf. lamina薄层，laminated层压的，layer层，veneer贴面） || 文化联想：中国家庭装修里常见强化复合地板，最适合帮助记忆 laminate，可以说 **laminate flooring — “Many apartment renovations use laminate flooring because it is easy to install and resembles wood at lower cost.”**

quiz.question: effeminate ______
quiz.explanation: 女性化的，女性化的举止。Critics unfairly described his gentle speech as an effeminate manner. 批评者不公平地将他温和的言谈描述为女性化的举止。 | ef->使，femin->女性（拉丁femina），effeminate->使像女性=女性化的（cf. feminine女性，feminism女权，female女性，femme女性） || 文化联想：旧社会常把男性温柔文弱的举止贴上“脂粉气”的标签，这种带刻板色彩的评价可帮助理解 effeminate，可以说 **an effeminate manner — “Traditional critics might unfairly describe a gentle or delicate male manner as effeminate simply because it did not match conventional ideals of masculinity.”**

quiz.question: disseminate ____
quiz.explanation: 传播，传播信息。Social media platforms can rapidly disseminate info to millions. 社交媒体平台可以迅速向数百万用户传播信息。 | dis->分散，semin->种子（拉丁semen），disseminate->像撒种子一样传播（cf. semen种子，seminary神学院=播种处，seminal开创性的） || 文化联想：古代邸报把朝廷消息传往各地，是很好的 disseminate 记忆钩子，可以说 **disseminate information — “Official bulletins helped disseminate information from the court to officials in distant regions.”**

quiz.question: eliminate _____
quiz.explanation: 消除，消除浪费。The company implemented lean manufacturing to eliminate waste. 公司实施精益生产以消除浪费。 | e->向外，limin->门槛（拉丁limen），eliminate->把...推出门槛外=消除（cf. preliminary预备=在门槛前，subliminal潜意识，liminal过渡的） || 文化联想：“光盘行动”强调减少餐桌浪费，最适合帮助记忆 eliminate，可以说 **eliminate food waste — “The ‘Clean Plate’ campaign encourages diners to order sensibly and eliminate unnecessary food waste.”**

quiz.question: discriminate _______
quiz.explanation: 歧视，歧视。It is illegal for employers to discriminate against applicants based on age. 雇主基于年龄歧视申请人是非法的。 | dis->分开，crimin->分辨（拉丁discernere），discriminate->分辨=区分/歧视（cf. crime犯罪，criminal罪犯，discern辨别，criterion标准） || 文化联想：传统“重男轻女”观念会造成对女孩和女性的不公平区别对待，最适合联想到 discriminate，可以说 **discriminate against women — “A rule that favors sons simply because they are male can discriminate against women and girls.”**

quiz.question: fulminate _______
quiz.explanation: 强烈抗议，强烈抗议。The senator took to the floor to fulminate against the proposed legislation. 参议员走上讲台强烈抗议拟议的立法。 | fulmen->闪电（拉丁），fulminate->像闪电般猛烈抗议（cf. fulminant爆发性的，thunder雷，lightning闪电，fulmination猛烈谴责） || 文化联想：海瑞上疏时以极其激烈的言辞批评朝政，很适合联想到 fulminate，可以说 **fulminate against corruption — “An outspoken censor might fulminate against corruption in a memorial filled with fierce moral condemnation.”**

quiz.question: abominate _______
quiz.explanation: 憎恶，憎恶残忍。People of conscience abominate cruelty toward animals. 有良知的人憎恶对动物的残忍。 | ab->离开，omin->预兆（拉丁omen），abominate->视为不吉预兆=憎恶（cf. omen预兆，ominous不祥，abominable可憎，abomination憎恶） || 文化联想：孟子所说的“恻隐之心”强调人应厌恶残忍、同情受苦者，很适合联想到 abominate，可以说 **abominate cruelty — “A person guided by compassion may abominate cruelty toward people or animals.”**

quiz.question: dominate ______
quiz.explanation: 主导，主导市场。The tech giant continued to dominate market share. 科技巨头继续主导市场份额。 | domin->主人（拉丁dominus），dominate->成为主人=主导（cf. domain领域，dominant主导，dominion统治，domineering专横，dominoes多米诺） || 文化联想：明清时期中国瓷器在许多海外市场极具影响力，可以帮助记忆 dominate，可以说 **dominate a market — “For long periods, Chinese porcelain helped dominate important segments of the international luxury ceramics market.”**

quiz.question: predominate __
quiz.explanation: 占主导地位，占主导地位于。Traditional values still predominate in rural communities. 传统价值观在农村社区仍占主导地位。 | pre->之前，dominate->主导，predominate->在前方主导=占优势（cf. dominant主导，dominate主导，preeminent杰出，prevail盛行） || 文化联想：春节装饰里红色往往占据最显眼的位置，最适合联想到 predominate，可以说 **red predominates — “During the Spring Festival, red often predominates in lanterns, couplets, envelopes, and other decorations.”**

quiz.question: nominate _ _________
quiz.explanation: 提名，提名候选人。The committee will meet to nominate a candidate for the position. 委员会将开会为该职位提名候选人。 | nomin->名字（拉丁nomen），nominate->用名字指定=提名（cf. name名字，noun名词，denomination命名，nominal名义上的） || 文化联想：现代协会或委员会开会推举候选人，就是 nominate 的典型场景，可以说 **nominate a candidate — “A committee may nominate a candidate for chair before the members vote.”**

quiz.question: denominate ________
quiz.explanation: 以...计价的货币，以...计价的货币。International bonds are often denominate currency in US dollars. 国际债券通常以美元计价。 | de->彻底，nomin->名字，denominate->命名=以...计价（cf. nominate提名，name名字，denomination面额/教派，noun名词） || 文化联想：以人民币计价的债券最适合帮助记忆 denominate，可以说 **a renminbi-denominated bond — “An overseas issuer may sell a renminbi-denominated bond whose principal and interest are stated in Chinese currency.”**

quiz.question: _____ germinate
